add_column_button.location: Results → Formula bar: primary button at the right of the formula input when creating a new computed column; computes the column now and writes its directive into the query.

apply_tooltip.value: 今すぐ列を計算し、-- sqlly column: としてクエリに書き込みます
apply_tooltip.location: Results → Formula bar: tooltip on the Add Column / Update Column button explaining that it computes the column from the formula and adds its comment directive to the query.

cancel_button.location: Results → Formula bar: secondary button after Add Column / Update Column that closes the formula bar without adding or changing the computed column.

collapsed_column_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Read-only view: computed column's name followed by an equals sign, shown before its colored formula when a cell of a computed column is selected; {column_name} is that column's name.

column_name_placeholder.location: Results → Formula bar: placeholder in the narrow name input left of the equals sign, where the user names the new or edited computed column.

comment_delimiters_forbidden.value: 式に/*や*/を含めることはできません。
comment_delimiters_forbidden.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: error shown in red after clicking Add/Update Column when the name or formula contains the SQL comment markers /* or */, which would break the query comment.

default_computed_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Column name input: default name prefilled for a new computed column when no column named this way exists yet (the first, unnumbered default).

default_computed_name_numbered.location: Results → Formula bar → Column name input: numbered default name prefilled for a new computed column when earlier defaults are already taken; {column_number} is 2, 3, and so on.

edit_formula_button.location: Results → Formula bar → Read-only view: small button at the right of the strip shown when a computed column's cell is selected; opens the formula bar to edit that column.

formula_guidance.value: Excel形式の式（IF、COALESCE、TEXT、DATE、SUMなど）を入力してください。列は!Nameの形式で指定します。
formula_guidance.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: dim hint shown while the formula input is still empty, explaining that Excel-style functions are allowed and columns are written as !Name.

formula_placeholder.location: Results → Formula bar: placeholder in the wide formula input right of the equals sign, shown when it is empty; the user types an Excel-style formula here.

invalid_name.value: 列名に=や改行を含めることはできません。
invalid_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: red error after clicking Add/Update Column when the computed column's name contains an equals sign or a line break.

name_required.value: 列名を入力してください。
name_required.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: red error after clicking Add/Update Column when the column name input is left empty (the message should say a name is required).

reference_guidance.value: 列は!Name、1つ前の行は!Name[1]、先頭行は!Name[$1]で参照します。
reference_guidance.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line: dim hint shown when the formula is valid but references no columns, reminding the user how to refer to columns in the formula.

spill_recompute_notice.value: 結果セット{result_number}はディスクから読み込まれるため、新しい列を計算するにはクエリを再実行してください。
spill_recompute_notice.location: Results → Messages tab → Computed columns: notice when computed columns change but a result set is paged from disk, so its new columns need a rerun; {result_number} is the result set's number.

update_column_button.location: Results → Formula bar: primary button at the right of the formula input when editing an existing computed column; recomputes it and updates its directive in the query.

invalid_number.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a number literal cannot be read; {value} is the offending text.

invalid_row_number.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a fixed row reference such as !Name[$1] has something other than a whole number after $; {reference} is the text inside the brackets.

invalid_row_offset.value: [{reference}]は行オフセットではありません。
invalid_row_offset.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a relative row reference such as !Name[1] or !Name[-1] has a non-number inside the brackets; {reference} is the bracket text.

missing_name.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a column marker ! or a variable marker @ is not followed by a name; {marker} is the symbol ! or @.

row_numbers_start_at_one.value: 行番号は$1から始まります。
row_numbers_start_at_one.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a fixed row reference uses $0 or a negative number; fixed rows are numbered from $1.

unclosed_quote.value: 引用符が閉じられていません。
unclosed_quote.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a double-quoted text value or quoted column name has no closing quote.

unclosed_row_reference.value: [ が閉じられていません。
unclosed_row_reference.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a row reference after a column (e.g. !Name[1) opens a square bracket that is never closed.

unexpected_character.value: 「{character}」はここでは使用できません。列は!Nameの形式で参照してください。
unexpected_character.location: Results → Formula validation: text ““{character}” can't be used here — refer to columns as !Name.”.

unknown_error_value.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when text after # is not one of the Excel error values such as #N/A, #DIV/0! or #VALUE!.

empty_formula.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when the formula has nothing after the equals sign.

missing_before_close_parenthesis.value: この ) の前に何かが足りません。
missing_before_close_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at a closing parenthesis that has no value before it, e.g. an empty argument in SUM(1, ).

missing_before_operator.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when an operator appears where a value was expected; {operator} is the operator symbol, such as + or *.

missing_between_parts.value: この2つの部分の間に何かが足りません。演算子かカンマではありませんか？
missing_between_parts.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when two values sit side by side with nothing joining them; suggests an operator or comma is missing.

missing_operand.value: ここに何かが足りません。
missing_operand.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at a comma or colon that has no value before it.

name_without_call.value: 「{name}」は関数呼び出しでも列でもありません。列は!{name}と書きます。
name_without_call.location: Results → Formula validation: text ““{name}” isn't a function call or a column — columns are written !{name}.”.

range_needs_references.value: 範囲には、コロンの両側に列参照が必要です。
range_needs_references.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when a range such as !A:!B has something other than a column reference on either side of the colon.

unclosed_function.value: {function_name}( が閉じられていません。
unclosed_function.location: Results → Formula validation: parse error at the end of an unclosed call to {function_name}.

unclosed_parenthesis.value: ( が閉じられていません。
unclosed_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when an opening parenthesis is never matched by a closing one.

unexpected_end.value: 式が途中で終わっています。
unexpected_end.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error when the formula stops where a value was still expected, e.g. it ends with an operator or comma.

unmatched_close_parenthesis.value: 対応する ( のない ) があります。
unmatched_close_parenthesis.location: Results → Formula bar → Formula status line (also inside the SQL editor warning for a computed-column comment line): formula error pointing at an extra closing parenthesis that has no opening parenthesis before it.

placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Go to Column popover: placeholder in the search input, opened from the grid context menu or command; typing filters the column names to jump to.

binary_cell_placeholder.location: Results → Grid → Cells: text shown in a cell whose value is binary data instead of the raw bytes; {byte_count} is the size of the value in bytes. Keep the angle brackets.

no_rows_returned.value: 行は返されませんでした
no_rows_returned.location: Results → Grid: dim empty-state message centered under the column headers when the query succeeded but returned zero rows.

invalid_between.value: betweenには<a>と<b>が必要です。「{operand}」は無効です
invalid_between.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment inserted into the “grid directive is ignored” warning when a between filter lacks “<a> and <b>”; {operand} is the text given. Lowercase; keep “and”.

invalid_freeze_count.value: freezeには列数が必要です。「{value}」は無効です
invalid_freeze_count.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when freeze= is not a whole number of columns; {value} is the text given. Keep the keyword “freeze”.

invalid_label_setting.value: labelには<column>:<display column|off>が必要です。「{value}」は無効です
invalid_label_setting.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when label= is not of the form column:display-column or column:off; {value} is the text given. Keep keywords.

invalid_number.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a numeric filter (e.g. >, between) is given a non-number; {value} is that text.

invalid_sort_direction.value: ソート方向はascまたはdescである必要があります（「{direction}」は無効）
invalid_sort_direction.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a sort= column is followed by something other than asc or desc; {direction} is that word. Keep asc/desc.

missing_column_name.value: 列名が欠落しています
missing_column_name.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a setting such as sort=, group=, filter= or label= is missing its column name. Lowercase fragment.

no_settings.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a “-- sqlly grid:” comment line has no settings after the colon. Lowercase fragment.

setting_not_key_value.value: 「{setting}」はkey=value形式の設定ではありません
setting_not_key_value.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a semicolon-separated part lacks an equals sign; {setting} is that part. Keep “key=value”.

unclosed_quote.value: 「{value}」内に閉じられていない引用符があります
unclosed_quote.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a double-quoted column name has no closing quote; {value} is the setting text containing it.

unexpected_after_column.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when extra text follows a quoted column name; {unexpected} is the extra text, {column_name} the column.

unknown_filter_operator.value: 「{value}」に不明なフィルター演算子があります
unknown_filter_operator.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when filter= uses an operator that is not recognized; {value} is the filter text given.

unknown_setting.location: SQL Editor → Directive warnings → Grid directive: error fragment in the ignored-directive warning when a setting name is not one of order, hide, freeze, sort, group, filter or label; {setting} is the unknown name.

center.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that centers this column’s values horizontally within their cells; middle option between Left and Right.

left.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that aligns this column’s values to the left edge of their cells; first of the three alignment options.

right.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Alignment submenu: menu item that aligns this column’s values to the right edge of their cells; last of the three alignment options.

export.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: menu item near the bottom, above the Tools submenu, that opens the export dialog for the selected cells or rows, where the format and destination are chosen.

go_to.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item that opens a prompt for jumping to a column of the result by name; useful on very wide results.

hide_empty.value: 空の列（すべてNULL）を非表示
hide_empty.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item that hides every column of this result whose values are all NULL; “all-NULL” explains what counts as empty.

narrow.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item right after Move Column Left/Right that makes the clicked column narrower by one step, as an alternative to dragging its header edge.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title grouping column-level commands such as hiding, resizing, going to a column and hiding all-NULL columns.

widen.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Column submenu: menu item right after Move Column Left/Right that makes the clicked column wider by one step, as an alternative to dragging its header edge.

add_column.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item that opens the formula editor to add a new Excel-style computed column next to the clicked column; values are calculated in the grid, not by the database.

edit_formula.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item shown only when the clicked column is a computed column; opens the formula editor so the user can change that column’s formula.

default_format.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: first copy menu item, copying the selection in the user’s default copy format; {format_name} is that format’s name, e.g. “TSV”, “CSV”, “JSON” or “Markdown”.

with_headers.value: ヘッダー付きでコピー
with_headers.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: menu item below the default Copy item that copies the selected cells to the clipboard with the column names as a header line.

format.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: one menu item per copy format other than the default one; {format_name} is the format’s name, e.g. “CSV”, “JSON Lines” or “SQL INSERT”.

headers.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: first menu item, which copies only the column names of the result (tab-separated) to the clipboard, without any values.

pretty_formatted.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds JSON, XML or similar structured data; copies the value re-indented and pretty-printed.

sql_in_list.value: SQL INリストとしてコピー
sql_in_list.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when the selection is in a single column; copies the selected values as a SQL list ready for an IN (…) clause.

sql_in_list_distinct.value: SQL INリストとしてコピー（重複なし）
sql_in_list_distinct.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: like “Copy as SQL IN list” but removes duplicate values first; shown only when the selection is in a single column.

sql_update.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Copy As submenu: menu item shown when whole rows or a clicked row are involved; opens a step to copy UPDATE statements built from the selected rows.

submenu.value: 形式を指定してコピー
submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title, next to the Copy items, that lists the alternative copy formats, header-only copy and SQL list/UPDATE copies.

empty.value: コピーする値はありません。
empty.location: Results → Messages tab: notice shown after a column value copy (distinct or top values) finds nothing to copy, e.g. the column is empty; the clipboard is left unchanged.

spill_sample_notice.value: {total_rows}行のうち先頭{copied_rows}行の値をコピーしました。この結果はディスクから部分的に読み込まれているため、残りの行は読み込まれていません。
spill_sample_notice.location: Results → Messages tab: notice after copying a column’s values from a very large result kept on disk; {copied_rows} is how many rows were read and copied, {total_rows} the full row count.

load_binary_file.value: ファイルから読み込み…
load_binary_file.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown for binary cells; opens a file picker and stages the chosen file’s bytes as the cell’s new value.

save_binary_file.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown for binary cells; opens a save dialog and writes the cell’s raw bytes to a file on disk.

set_current_user.value: 現在のユーザーに設定（SQL）
set_current_user.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that stages the database’s current-user SQL function as the new value, so the server fills in the login name; “(SQL)” marks a server-evaluated value.

set_default.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item that stages the keyword DEFAULT for the clicked cell, so the column’s database default is applied on save; keep “DEFAULT” as the SQL keyword.

set_false.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown only for boolean columns that stages the value false for the clicked cell; pairs with “Set true”.

set_local_timestamp.value: 現在のタイムスタンプに設定（ローカル時刻）
set_local_timestamp.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for date or time cells that stages the current date and time read from this computer’s clock, not the server’s.

set_new_uuid.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that generates a new random UUID in the app and stages it as the cell’s value.

set_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: first menu item, staging NULL (no value) for the clicked cell; keep “NULL” as the SQL keyword.

set_server_date.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for date or time cells that stages the database’s current-date SQL function, evaluated by the server when the change is saved; “(SQL)” marks that.

set_server_time.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item, always offered beside Set NULL and Set DEFAULT, that stages the database server’s current time as the clicked cell’s new value.

set_server_uuid.value: サーバー生成のUUIDに設定（SQL）
set_server_uuid.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item for text cells that stages the database’s UUID-generating SQL function, so the server creates the UUID when the change is saved.

set_true.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: menu item shown only for boolean columns that stages the value true for the clicked cell; pairs with “Set false”.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: submenu title, shown when a data cell (not a row header) is right-clicked, grouping commands that stage a new value for that cell.

transform_action.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Edit Cell submenu: one menu item per text transform for non-empty text cells; {transform_name} is the transform, e.g. “Uppercase” or “Trim whitespace”; stages the transformed text.

no_actions.value: 使用可能なアクションはありません
no_actions.location: Results → Grid → Context menu: single disabled placeholder item shown when right-clicking a spot in the grid where no command applies.

preparing_spill_rows.value: エクスポートを準備中 — ディスクから{row_count}行を読み込んでいます…
preparing_spill_rows.location: Results → Grid → Caption strip above the grid: progress note shown while an export waits for rows of a very large result stored on disk; {row_count} is the number of rows being read.

active_to_where.value: 現在のフィルターをWHEREに追加
active_to_where.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Filter submenu: menu item that turns the grid’s currently active column filters into a WHERE clause added to the query in the editor.

quick_contains.value: フィルター：{column_name}に{cell_value}が含まれる
quick_contains.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that filters the grid to rows whose {column_name} contains the clicked value {cell_value}; changes the grid only, not the SQL.

quick_equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that filters the grid to rows where {column_name} equals the clicked value {cell_value}; changes the grid only, not the SQL.

quick_is_not_null.value: フィルター：{column_name} IS NOT NULL
quick_is_not_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that keeps only grid rows where {column_name} (the clicked column) has a value; offered even on NULL cells; changes the grid only.

quick_is_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that keeps only grid rows where {column_name} (the clicked column) is NULL; offered even on NULL cells; changes the grid only.

quick_not_equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: quick-filter item that hides grid rows where {column_name} equals the clicked value {cell_value}; “<>” is the not-equal operator; grid only.

rows_builder.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Filter submenu: last menu item, opening the Filter Rows builder dialog for combining several column conditions on this grid.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title grouping quick grid filters on the clicked value, “Add WHERE …” query edits and the filter builder.

hide_column_label.value: 外部キーラベル：ラベルを非表示
hide_column_label.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: menu item shown when this foreign-key column currently shows a label from the referenced row; turns it off for this column only.

hide_globally.value: 外部キーラベルを非表示
hide_globally.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: last item, shown while labels are on; turns off the readable labels beside foreign-key values in every result grid.

off.location: Results → Grid context menu → Foreign Key Label: command that turns off the display-column label for the clicked foreign-key column.

show_column_label.value: 外部キーラベル：ラベルを表示
show_column_label.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: menu item shown when this foreign-key column has no label; shows a readable label from the referenced row beside each key value.

show_globally.value: 外部キーラベルを表示
show_globally.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: last item, shown while labels are off everywhere; turns on readable labels beside foreign-key values in every result grid.

use_display_column.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Foreign Key Label submenu: item choosing which column of the referenced table supplies the label; {column_name} is that column’s name.

alignment_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title holding the Left, Center and Right options for horizontally aligning this column’s values.

cell_masking_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Format submenu: nested submenu title holding data-masking commands for the clicked cell’s column (reveal, re-mask, always/never mask, Masking Rules).

cell_override.value: 列のフォーマットオーバーライドを設定…
cell_override.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu → Format submenu: first menu item, opening the dialog that sets a display format override (number, date, etc.) for the clicked cell’s column.

cell_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: submenu title near the bottom, grouping the column formatting override and the masking commands for the clicked cell’s column.

conditional.value: 条件付きフォーマット…
conditional.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: menu item that opens the Conditional Formatting dialog for this column, where color rules based on cell values are set.

foreign_key_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title shown only for foreign-key columns that can show labels; holds choices for the readable label shown beside each key value.

header_override.value: フォーマットオーバーライドを設定…
header_override.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: first menu item, opening the dialog that sets a display format override (number, date, etc.) for the clicked column.

header_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title after Column and Values, grouping formatting override, conditional formatting, alignment, rounding, foreign-key label and masking for this column.

masking_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: last nested submenu title, holding data-masking commands for the clicked column (reveal, re-mask, always/never mask, Masking Rules).

rounding_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format submenu: submenu title shown for numeric columns that can carry decimals; holds choices for how many decimal places to display.

export.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: menu item above the Tools submenu that opens the export dialog for the result, where the format and destination are chosen.

canvas.value: キャンバスレイアウト
canvas.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that switches how multiple result sets are arranged to a free-form canvas of movable panels.

reset_columns.value: 列レイアウトをリセット
reset_columns.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that restores this grid’s column widths and order to their defaults.

stacked.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that arranges multiple result sets stacked vertically, one grid under another.

tabbed.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools → Layout submenu: menu item that shows multiple result sets as tabs, one grid visible at a time.

always_mask_connection.value: この接続では常に{col_label}をマスク
always_mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that adds a connection-level rule always masking {col_label}.

manage_rules.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: last menu item, opening the Settings masking rules page where global data-masking rules are edited.

mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that masks {col_label} on the current connection.

never_mask_connection.value: この接続では{col_label}をマスクしない
never_mask_connection.location: Results → Grid context menu → Masking: command that adds a connection-level exception preventing {col_label} from being masked.

remask_result.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown on a masked column; hides again every value that was revealed in this result.

reveal_cell.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown only when the clicked cell is masked; shows the real value of that one cell.

reveal_column.value: この結果の列のマスクを解除
reveal_column.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: shown on a masked column; shows the real values of the whole column for this result only.

this_column.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Format → Masking submenu: fallback lowercase phrase inserted into the always/never-mask item labels when the column name is unknown; must read naturally mid-sentence.

export.location: Results → Pivot tab → Grid context menu: the only item on the pivot grid’s menu, opening the export dialog for the pivoted cells.

submenu.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools submenu (Redis key listings such as SQLLY.KEYS): submenu holding actions on the selected keys.

delete.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools → Redis Keys submenu: deletes the keys in the selected rows after a confirmation that lists them.

set_ttl.value: 選択したキーのTTLを設定…
set_ttl.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools → Redis Keys submenu: sets an expiry (TTL in seconds) on the keys in the selected rows.

persist.value: 選択したキーの有効期限を解除…
persist.location: Results grid → Context menu → Tools → Redis Keys submenu: removes the expiry (PERSIST) from the keys in the selected rows.

four_decimals.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Rounding submenu: menu item that displays this numeric column rounded to 4 decimal places.

one_decimal.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Rounding submenu: menu item that displays this numeric column rounded to 1 decimal place (singular).

six_decimals.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Rounding submenu: menu item that displays this numeric column rounded to 6 decimal places, the most precise choice.

two_decimals.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Rounding submenu: menu item that displays this numeric column rounded to 2 decimal places.

zero_decimals.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Format → Rounding submenu: first menu item, displaying this numeric column rounded to whole numbers (0 decimal places).

batch_insert.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that opens the row editor in batch mode for inserting several new rows at once into the source table.

duplicate.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that opens the row editor prefilled with the clicked row’s values, to insert a copy directly into the table.

insert.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that opens the row editor with empty fields to insert a new row directly into the source table.

revert_staged.value: ステージした変更を破棄
revert_staged.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: last menu item, discarding any pending (staged, not yet saved) edit, insert or delete on the clicked row.

stage_delete.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that marks the clicked or selected rows for deletion as a pending change, applied only when staged changes are saved.

stage_duplicate.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: like Duplicate Row, but the copy is added as a pending (staged) insert saved later together with other staged changes.

stage_duplicate_without_key.value: 複製をステージ（キーをクリア）…
stage_duplicate_without_key.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: staged duplicate of the clicked row with its primary-key values cleared, so the database can assign new keys on save.

stage_edit.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that opens the row editor whose changes are kept as pending (staged) edits instead of being saved at once.

stage_insert.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu → Row submenu: menu item that opens an empty row editor whose new row is kept as a pending (staged) insert until changes are saved.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Row header context menu: submenu title at the top of the menu when a row-number header is right-clicked; groups insert, duplicate, staged edit and delete commands.

select_all.location: Results → Grid → Cell and row header context menu: menu item below the Copy As submenu that selects every cell of this result grid.

add_ascending.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Sort & Filter submenu: adds this column to the existing sort as an extra ascending key, keeping the current sort columns.

descending.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Sort & Filter submenu: menu item that sorts the grid by this column in descending order (largest or latest values first).

filter_rows.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Sort & Filter submenu: last menu item, opening the Filter Rows builder dialog for combining several column conditions on this grid.

remove.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Sort & Filter submenu: removes only this column from the current multi-column sort, keeping the other sort columns.

submenu.value: 並べ替えとフィルター
submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title after the sort and filter items, grouping clear-sort, clear-filter, multi-column sort and filter builder commands.

chart.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Tools submenu: menu item that brings forward the grid’s Chart tab to plot this result set.

client_statistics.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: menu item that opens the Client Statistics window with timing and row/byte counts for recent query runs.

find_replace.value: グリッド内を検索・置換…
find_replace.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: first menu item, opening a find and replace bar that searches values across every column of this result.

layout_submenu.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: nested submenu title holding the stacked/tabbed/canvas arrangement of result sets and the column layout reset.

open_spreadsheet.value: スプレッドシートで開く
open_spreadsheet.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: exports the result to a workbook and opens it in the default spreadsheet app (downloads it in the browser version).

save_chart.value: チャートをライブラリに保存…
save_chart.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Tools submenu: menu item that saves the result’s current chart to the saved charts library, asking for a name.

save_snapshot.value: スナップショットとして保存…
save_snapshot.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: menu item that asks for a name and saves a snapshot copy of this result set for later viewing or comparison.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Context menu: last submenu title on both cell and column header menus, grouping grid-wide tools such as find, statistics, transpose, spreadsheet, snapshot and layout.

transpose.location: Results → Grid → Context menu → Tools submenu: menu item that toggles a transposed view, swapping rows and columns of this result grid.

copy_distinct.value: 重複のない値をコピー
copy_distinct.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: first menu item, copying each distinct value of this column once, one per line, to the clipboard.

copy_profile_markdown.value: 列プロファイルをMarkdownでコピー
copy_profile_markdown.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: copies a statistics profile of this column (counts, nulls, min/max, frequent values) to the clipboard as a Markdown table.

copy_top_frequent.value: 上位{value_count}件の値をコピー（頻度の高い順）
copy_top_frequent.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: copies the column’s most common values, most frequent first, one per line; {value_count} is how many values are copied.

profile_all.value: すべての列をプロファイル
profile_all.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: last menu item, opening the data profile view with statistics for every column of this result.

profile_column.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: menu item that shows a statistics profile (counts, nulls, min/max, frequent values) for the clicked column only.

submenu.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu: submenu title between Column and Format, grouping commands that copy distinct or frequent values and profile the column’s data.

top_values.location: Results → Grid → Column header context menu → Values submenu: menu item that opens a view listing this column’s most frequent values with their counts.

binary_as_hex.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds an unmasked binary value; opens the value viewer showing the bytes as hexadecimal.

cell_details.location: Results grid → cell right-click menu → Edit Cell submenu: first item, opens the Cell Details panel on the clicked cell, where its full value can be read and edited.

full_value.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell displays only a truncated preview; opens the value viewer with the complete, untruncated value.

geometry.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds spatial data (geometry/geography); opens a viewer that draws the shape.

image.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds image data; opens a viewer that displays the picture.

masked_binary_as_hex.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell is a masked binary value; opens the hexadecimal viewer for its bytes (same wording as the unmasked binary item).

plain_value.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown for plain non-empty text cells; opens the value viewer, where the text can be re-read as UTF-8, JSON, hex and other formats.

referenced_row.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown for non-NULL foreign-key cells; opens the row of the referenced table that this key value points to.

structured_data.value: 構造化データビューアを開く
structured_data.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu: menu item shown when the clicked cell holds JSON, XML or similar structured text; opens the structured data viewer with the value formatted.

active_filters_title.location: Results → Grid → Filter → Add Active Filters to WHERE: title naming the query edit that adds the grid’s active column filters to the editor’s WHERE clause.

between.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: shown when exactly two cells of one column are selected; adds WHERE {column_name} BETWEEN the two values to the query; keep the SQL keywords.

contains.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: for text cells; adds a WHERE condition to the editor’s query that {column_name} contains the clicked text {cell_value} (a LIKE pattern).

does_not_contain.value: WHERE {column_name}に'{cell_value}'を含まない条件を追加
does_not_contain.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: for text cells; adds a WHERE condition to the query that {column_name} does not contain the clicked text {cell_value} (NOT LIKE).

ends_with.value: WHERE {column_name}が'{cell_value}'で終わる条件を追加
ends_with.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter submenu: for text cells; adds a WHERE condition to the editor’s query that {column_name} ends with the clicked text {cell_value}.

equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu (top level): item for “column equals this cell’s value”, promoted out of the Filter submenu as the most common filter; adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

greater_than.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for number or date cells: “column greater than this value”; adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

greater_than_or_equal.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for number or date cells: “column greater than or equal to this value”; adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

in_list.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item shown when several cells of one column are selected; adds an IN list of those values to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor. {column_name} is the column; “(...)” stands for the values.

is_not_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: menu item that adds “column IS NOT NULL” to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor; also the only filters offered when the cell holds only a cut-short preview. {column_name} is the clicked column. Keep the SQL keywords untranslated.

is_null.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: menu item that adds “column IS NULL” to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor; offered for any cell, including a cut-short preview cell. {column_name} is the clicked column. Keep the SQL keywords untranslated.

less_than.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for number or date cells: “column less than this value”; adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

less_than_or_equal.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for number or date cells: “column less than or equal to this value”; adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

match_row.value: WHERE句をこの行に一致させる
match_row.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: last menu item, offered when every cell of the clicked row has a comparable value; rewrites the query in the editor so its WHERE clause matches this exact row (an AND of equals over every column). Nothing runs.

not_equals.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for “column is not equal to this value” (SQL <> operator); adds it to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor without running. {column_name} is the column, {cell_value} the clicked value; keep SQL keywords untranslated.

not_in_list.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item shown when several cells of one column are selected; adds a NOT IN list excluding those values to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor. {column_name} is the column.

starts_with.value: WHERE {column_name}が'{cell_value}'で始まる条件を追加
starts_with.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Filter: item for text cells that adds a LIKE prefix condition (column starts with the clicked text) to the query’s WHERE clause in the editor. {column_name} is the column; {cell_value} the text.

sort_chip.location: Results → Results toolbar → Multi-column sort chip: chip label shown only while the grid is sorted by two or more columns; clicking it clears the sort. {column_directions} is a comma-separated list such as “name ↑, date ↓”.

browser_unavailable.value: クエリのバージョン履歴は利用できません
browser_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Results → History output tab: feature name inserted into the browser-preview “not available here” notice that fills the History pane, because query version history needs the desktop app. Sentence fragment; no final period.

native_unavailable.value: クエリのバージョン履歴は利用できません。
native_unavailable.location: Results → History output tab: centered dim placeholder in the desktop app shown when no query version-history panel is attached to this results area, explaining that version history cannot be shown here. Full sentence.

unnamed_column.location: Results → Grid → Truncated-cell value viewer: fallback column name used as the viewer window title when a cut-short cell is opened in full and its result column has no name. {column_number} is the 1-based column position; lowercase noun phrase.

browser_local_files_unavailable.value: ローカルファイルのインポートは利用できません
browser_local_files_unavailable.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → browser preview: feature description inserted into the browser-unavailable message when local file import cannot be used.

bulk_insert_fallback.value: BULK INSERTにはSQL Serverと既存のテーブルが必要なため、INSERT文としてスクリプト化しました
bulk_insert_fallback.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved import profile that chose BULK INSERT when the connection is not SQL Server or the target is a new table, saying the script falls back to INSERT statements. Keep BULK INSERT and INSERT untranslated.

bytes_even_hex_digits_required.value: $bytesには偶数個の16進数の桁が必要です
bytes_even_hex_digits_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file or snapshot) shown when a binary cell’s “$bytes” value has an odd number of hex digits or non-hex characters. Keep “$bytes” literal.

bytes_hex_string_required.value: $bytesは16進数文字列である必要があります
bytes_hex_string_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file or snapshot) shown when a binary cell’s “$bytes” value in a SQLLY Export file is not a text string. Keep “$bytes” literal.

choose_file_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source toolbar: button that opens the file picker for a CSV, JSON, Excel, or SQLLY Export source.

clipboard_empty.value: クリップボードにインポートするテキストがありません
clipboard_empty.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown after clicking “Paste from clipboard”, or opening the wizard from the clipboard, when the clipboard holds no text to import.

clipboard_source_label.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source name shown in place of a file path after pasting data from the clipboard. {line_count} is the number of pasted lines (including any header).

column_mapping_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: label to the left of the optional source-to-target column-mapping input.

column_types_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: label to the left of the optional per-column type-overrides input.

create_table.value: 新しいテーブルを作成
create_table.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source options: checkbox that targets a new table instead of an existing table.

default_column_name.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview grid and Column mapping: generated column name used when the file has no header row, or a header cell is blank. {column_number} is the 1-based column position; written with no space, like an identifier (Column1, Column2…).

default_profile_cleared.value: デフォルトを解除しました
default_profile_cleared.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Default button: status-bar success message shown after clicking Default on a profile that was already the default, so it no longer applies automatically.

default_profile_set.value: デフォルトプロファイルを設定しました。{schema_name}.{table_name}に自動的に適用されます
default_profile_set.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Default button: status-bar success message shown after marking the selected import profile as the default, which then applies automatically whenever importing into that table. {schema_name}.{table_name} is the target table.

delimiter_comma.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects comma as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: label to the left of the comma, semicolon, tab, and pipe selector chips.

delimiter_pipe.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects the pipe character as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_semicolon.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects semicolon as the delimited-file separator.

delimiter_tab.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → delimiter options: chip that selects tab as the delimited-file separator.

dialog_title.value: インポート/エクスポート
dialog_title.location: Results → Import / Export dialog: title at the top of the script-first import and export wizard.

empty_preview.value: CSV、JSON、Excel（.xlsx、.xls）、または.sqllyexportファイルを選択すると、ここにプレビューが表示されます。
empty_preview.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → preview pane: desktop empty state shown before a supported import file has been chosen.

export_select_button.value: エクスポート用SELECTをスクリプト化
export_select_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: button that scripts a SELECT statement for exporting the target table.

export_table_required.value: 先にエクスポートするテーブル名を指定してください
export_table_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Script Export SELECT button: status-bar message shown when the button is clicked while the target table name field is empty.

file_and_target_required.value: まずファイルとターゲットテーブルを選択してください
file_and_target_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Script Import to Editor button: status-bar message shown when no import script can be generated yet because no file (or pasted data) or no target table has been given.

file_read_failed.value: ファイルを読み込めませんでした：{error}
file_read_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen import file cannot be opened or read from disk. {error} is the operating-system error text.

file_size_limit.value: インポートファイルの上限は64MiBです
file_size_limit.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen import file is larger than the 64 MiB import limit.

first_row_header.value: 先頭行をヘッダーにする
first_row_header.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source options: checkbox that treats the first delimited-file row as column headers.

invalid_cell_type.value: 有効な{expected_type}ではありません
invalid_cell_type.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Rejected-rows warning: short reason fragment explaining why a row is rejected, shown in brackets after the offending value and in the generated script comment. {expected_type} is the column’s type keyword (int, date, uuid…); lowercase, no period.

invalid_json.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when the chosen .json import file is not valid JSON. {error} is the parser’s technical detail.

invalid_sqlly_export.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file or saved snapshot) shown when a SQLLY Export file is not valid JSON or lacks required fields. {error} is the parser detail.

invalid_sqlly_export_cell.value: SQLLYエクスポートのセルは、null、boolean、number、string、または$bytesである必要があります
invalid_sqlly_export_cell.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also shown in the status bar when opening a .sqllyexport file) when a cell in a SQLLY Export file is an unsupported JSON value such as an array or object. Keep “$bytes” literal.

json_array_required.value: オブジェクトを要素とするJSON配列が必要です
json_array_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when a .json import file is neither an array of objects nor an object wrapping such an array.

json_elements_must_be_objects.value: JSON配列の各要素はオブジェクトである必要があります
json_elements_must_be_objects.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error shown when a .json import file’s array contains an item that is not an object (for example a number or a nested array).

loading_preview.value: バックグラウンドでインポートを読み込んで解析しています…
loading_preview.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → preview pane: status shown while the selected import is read and parsed in the background.

mapping_all_columns_skipped.value: 列マッピングはすべてのソース列をスキップします
mapping_all_columns_skipped.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when every entry in the mapping is “-”, so no source column would be imported.

mapping_bulk_insert_warning.value: 列マッピングはレビュー用のINSERTスクリプトでのみ使用できます。マッピングをクリアするか、BULK INSERT以外に切り替えてください。
mapping_bulk_insert_warning.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: warning shown when a nonempty column mapping is incompatible with BULK INSERT.

mapping_count_mismatch.value: 列マッピングには{entry_count}個のエントリがありますが、ファイルには{column_count}列あります
mapping_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when the comma-separated mapping has a different number of entries than the file has columns. {entry_count} is entries typed; {column_count} is source columns.

mapping_dropped_columns.value: ソース列{column_names}はこのファイルに存在しないため、そのマッピングは削除されました
mapping_dropped_columns.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile whose mapping named source columns missing from the current file, so those mappings were dropped. {column_names} is a comma-separated list; lowercase fragment joined with other notes.

mapping_duplicate_target.value: ターゲット列{target_name}が複数回マッピングされています
mapping_duplicate_target.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when two entries in the mapping name the same target column (case-insensitive). {target_name} is the repeated column name.

mapping_missing_target.value: マッピングされた列{column_number}にターゲット名がありません
mapping_missing_target.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping field: red validation error below the inputs when an entry in the comma-separated mapping is blank instead of a target name or “-”. {column_number} is that entry’s 1-based position.

mapping_new_columns_skipped.value: 新しいソース列{column_names}はスキップ(-) — テーブルにある場合はマッピングしてください
mapping_new_columns_skipped.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile when the file has source columns the profile did not know, which are mapped to “-” (skipped). {column_names} is a comma-separated list; lowercase fragment; keep “(-)”.

mapping_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column mapping input: placeholder showing the comma-separated syntax, one target column name per source column, with “-” to skip a column. The sample identifiers and “-” may stay as-is; translate only “Optional”.

no_file_chosen.value: ファイルが選択されていません
no_file_chosen.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: text shown before any file has been chosen or data pasted, in place of the source file path.

null_token_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → mapping controls: label to the left of the optional input for text that represents NULL.

null_token_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Null token input: placeholder for the optional text that should be read as SQL NULL when found in a cell. Keep the example “NULL” untranslated.

number_out_of_range.value: 数値がSQLLYのサポート範囲外です
number_out_of_range.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a numeric cell in a SQLLY Export file is too large or not finite for SQLLY to hold.

paste_clipboard_button.value: クリップボードから貼り付け
paste_clipboard_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source toolbar: desktop button that imports delimited text from the clipboard.

preview_footer.value: データ{data_row_count}行 · スクリプトはレビュー用に新しいタブで開きます — ここからは何も実行されません
preview_footer.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: row-count and script-safety note shown when every data row fits in the preview.

preview_footer_limited.value: 先頭{preview_row_count}行をプレビュー（全{data_row_count}行） · スクリプトはレビュー用に新しいタブで開きます — ここからは何も実行されません
preview_footer_limited.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: truncated-preview counts and script-safety note shown when the import has more rows than the preview displays.

profile_connection_required.value: インポートプロファイルは保存済みの接続ごとに管理されます — 接続からウィザードを開いてください
profile_connection_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when saving a profile from a wizard not opened from a saved connection, since profiles are stored per connection.

profile_default_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that toggles the selected import profile as the default for the target table.

profile_delete_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that deletes the selected import profile.

profile_deleted.value: インポートプロファイルを削除しました
profile_deleted.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Delete button: status-bar success message shown after the selected import profile is deleted.

profile_drift_notice.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: notice line under the profile controls shown after a saved profile is applied but parts of it no longer fit the current file. {profile_name} is the profile; {notices} is a semicolon-separated list of the issues.

profile_name_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: placeholder in the text input where the user types a name for saving or renaming an import profile.

profile_name_required.value: 先にプロファイル名を入力してください
profile_name_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when Save is clicked while the profile name input is empty.

profile_rename_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that renames the selected import profile to the entered profile name.

profile_renamed.value: プロファイル名を「{profile_name}」に変更しました
profile_renamed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar success message shown after the selected import profile is renamed. {profile_name} is the new name.

profile_save_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: button that saves the current import settings under the entered profile name.

profile_saved.value: インポートプロファイル「{profile_name}」を保存しました
profile_saved.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar success message shown after the wizard’s current settings are saved as an import profile (overwriting one of the same name). {profile_name} is its name.

profile_selection_required.value: まずプロファイルを選択してください
profile_selection_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename, Delete, or Default button: status-bar message shown when one of those buttons is clicked while no profile is selected in the profile dropdown.

profile_sheet_missing.value: シート「{sheet_name}」がこのワークブックにありません
profile_sheet_missing.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Profile notice: note listed after applying a saved profile that names an Excel sheet not present in the chosen workbook. {sheet_name} is that sheet; lowercase fragment joined with other notes.

profile_target_required.value: 先にターゲットテーブルを設定してください — プロファイルはそのテーブル単位で保存されます
profile_target_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save button: status-bar message shown when Save is clicked before a target table name is entered, because each profile belongs to one target table.

profiles_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → profile controls: label to the left of the saved-import-profile selector and name input.

profiles_unavailable.value: インポートプロファイルを利用できません：{error}
profiles_unavailable.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles row: notice under the profile controls shown when the saved import-profiles file cannot be read, so no profiles are listed. {error} is the technical reason.

proposed_columns.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → new-table settings: summary of the column names and inferred types proposed for the new table.

rejected_row_detail.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: detail for one rejected row, including its row number, column, source value, and rejection reason.

rejected_rows_omitted.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: final detail indicating how many rejected rows are omitted after the first five details.

rejected_rows_summary.value: 型の不一致により{rejected_count}行が拒否されます：{details}
rejected_rows_summary.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: plural summary introducing the rejected-row details when more than one row will be rejected.

rejected_rows_summary_one.value: 型の不一致により{rejected_count}行が拒否されます：{details}
rejected_rows_summary_one.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → type-mismatch warning: singular summary introducing the rejected-row detail when exactly one row will be rejected.

row_cell_count_mismatch.value: 行{row_number}のセル数は{cell_count}で、列数{column_count}と一致しません
row_cell_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a row in a SQLLY Export file has more cells than it declares columns. {row_number} is 1-based; {cell_count} and {column_count} are counts.

script_as_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: label to the left of the INSERT statements and BULK INSERT selector chips.

script_bulk_insert.value: BULK INSERT（サーバーがファイルを読み込む）
script_bulk_insert.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: chip that selects a server-side BULK INSERT script for SQL Server with an existing target table.

script_import_button.value: インポートスクリプトをエディタで開く
script_import_button.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → footer: primary button that opens the reviewed import script in a new editor tab without executing it.

script_insert_statements.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → script options: chip that selects per-row or batched INSERT statements for review.

sheet_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → source options: label to the left of the worksheet selector for Excel imports.

sheet_read_failed.value: シート「{sheet_name}」を読み込めませんでした：{error}
sheet_read_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the selected sheet of an Excel workbook cannot be read. {sheet_name} is the sheet tab name; {error} is the technical detail.

sheet_row_limit.value: シートは1,000,000行に制限されています
sheet_row_limit.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the selected Excel sheet has more than one million non-empty rows, the import limit.

source_metadata_all.value: {source} · エンコーディング：{encoding} · 置換文字あり · エラーセル{error_cell_count}個をNULLとして読み込み
source_metadata_all.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label when the file’s encoding was detected, some characters could not be decoded and were replaced, and some Excel error cells were read as NULL. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding; {error_cell_count} a count.

source_metadata_encoding.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for a text file whose character encoding was detected and decoded cleanly. {source} is the file path; {encoding} is the encoding name such as UTF-8.

source_metadata_encoding_lossy.value: {source} · エンコーディング：{encoding} · 置換文字あり
source_metadata_encoding_lossy.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for a text file whose encoding was detected but some bytes could not be decoded and were shown as replacement characters. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding name.

source_metadata_encoding_sheet_errors.value: {source} · エンコーディング：{encoding} · エラーセル{error_cell_count}個をNULLとして読み込み
source_metadata_encoding_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label with a detected encoding plus a count of spreadsheet error cells (such as #DIV/0!) imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {encoding} the encoding; {error_cell_count} the count.

source_metadata_lossy.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label when no encoding name is shown but some characters could not be decoded and appear as replacement characters. {source} is the file path or clipboard label.

source_metadata_lossy_sheet_errors.value: {source} · 置換文字あり · エラーセル{error_cell_count}個をNULLとして読み込み
source_metadata_lossy_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label combining undecodable characters shown as replacements and a count of spreadsheet error cells imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {error_cell_count} the count.

source_metadata_plain.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label with no extra details, only the chosen file path or the “Clipboard (N lines)” label. {source} is that text; usually kept as is.

source_metadata_sheet_errors.value: {source} · エラーセル{error_cell_count}個をNULLとして読み込み
source_metadata_sheet_errors.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Source line beside the file chooser: source label for an Excel workbook where some cells held spreadsheet errors (such as #N/A) that were imported as NULL. {source} is the path; {error_cell_count} the count.

sqlly_export_column_cap.value: SQLLYエクスポートの列数は1〜{column_cap}列である必要があります
sqlly_export_column_cap.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file has no columns or more than the supported maximum. {column_cap} is that maximum.

sqlly_export_row_cap.value: SQLLYエクスポートがインポート上限の{row_cap}行を超えています
sqlly_export_row_cap.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file has more rows than can be imported. {row_cap} is the row limit; “{row_cap}-row” is an adjective.

target_label.location: Results → Import / Export dialog → target controls: label to the left of the target schema and table inputs.

target_table_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Target row: placeholder in the table-name input beside the schema input, naming the table to import into. Written as one identifier-like word with no space.

type_count_mismatch.value: 列の型には{entry_count}個のエントリがありますが、ファイルには{column_count}列あります
type_count_mismatch.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types field: red validation error under the Column types input when its comma-separated list has a different number of entries than the file has columns. {entry_count} is entries typed; {column_count} is source columns.

types_placeholder.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types input: placeholder showing the comma-separated per-column type list, where “auto” keeps the detected type. Keep the type keywords (int, text, date, auto) untranslated; translate only “Optional”.

unknown_column_type.value: 不明な列の型「{type_name}」— text、int、decimal、bool、date、datetime、uuid、autoのいずれかを指定してください
unknown_column_type.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Column types field: red validation error when an entry is not a recognized type keyword. {type_name} is what the user typed; the listed keywords (text, int, decimal, bool, date, datetime, uuid, auto) must stay untranslated.

unsupported_source_engine.value: サポート対象外のSQLLYエクスポートソースエンジン：{engine_name}
unsupported_source_engine.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when a SQLLY Export file names a source database engine SQLLY does not know. {engine_name} is that name.

unsupported_sqlly_export_version.value: サポート対象外のSQLLYエクスポート形式またはバージョンです
unsupported_sqlly_export_version.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red parse error (also a status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file) shown when the file is not a SQLLY Export or uses a format version this SQLLY version cannot read.

workbook_no_sheets.value: ワークブックにはシートがありません
workbook_no_sheets.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen Excel workbook contains no worksheets to import.

workbook_open_failed.value: ワークブックを開けませんでした：{error}
workbook_open_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Preview area: red error shown when the chosen Excel workbook (.xlsx, .xls) cannot be opened, for example because it is corrupt or password-protected. {error} is the technical detail.

default_label.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles dropdown: list entry for the profile marked as default for its table, which applies automatically. {profile_name} is the profile; {table_name} is its target table (schema.table); keep “(default)” short.

duplicate_name.value: このテーブルには「{profile_name}」というプロファイルがすでに存在します
duplicate_name.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when renaming a profile to a name another profile for the same target table already uses (case-insensitive). {profile_name} is the requested name.

label.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles dropdown: list entry for an ordinary (non-default) saved import profile. {profile_name} is the profile name; {table_name} is the target table it belongs to (schema.table).

name_required.value: 先にプロファイル名を入力してください
name_required.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when Rename is clicked while the profile name input is empty.

no_longer_exists.value: プロファイルはすでに削除されています
no_longer_exists.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Rename button: status-bar message shown when the selected profile was removed from the profiles file (for example in another window) before it could be renamed.

save_blocked.value: {error}。インポートプロファイルは保存されていません — 先にそのファイルを修正するか移動してください
save_blocked.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save, Rename, Delete, Default buttons: status-bar error when the existing import-profiles file is corrupt, so SQLLY refuses to overwrite it. {error} is the read error, ending the first sentence.

save_failed.location: Tools → Import / Export dialog → Profiles → Save, Rename, Delete, Default buttons: status-bar error when writing the import-profiles file to disk fails. {file_path} is the file’s path; {error} is the operating-system error.

canvas_too_large.value: 結果レイアウトを無視：キャンバス{rows}x{columns}は最大{maximum_rows}x{maximum_columns}を超えています。
canvas_too_large.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle error on the first-line canvas comment (for example “-- sqlly 4x2”) when its grid is bigger than allowed, so the layout is ignored. {rows}x{columns} is the requested size; {maximum_rows}x{maximum_columns} is the limit.

control_label.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: label of the clickable control beside the Export link that toggles multiple result sets between stacked cards and one tab per result set.

dangling_placement.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}に、結果を生成するステートメントが続いていません。
dangling_placement.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement comment not followed by any statement that returns rows, so it places nothing. {placement} is the comment’s row|column value.

hidden_problem_count.value: …ほか{hidden_count}件のレイアウトの問題。
hidden_problem_count.location: Results → Canvas layout: last note line under the canvas board when more than three runtime layout problems occurred, counting the ones not listed. {hidden_count} is that number; “problem(s)” covers singular and plural.

malformed_placement_ranges.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}の形式が正しくありません。正の整数の範囲が必要です。
malformed_placement_ranges.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement whose row or column part is not a positive whole number or range like 1-2. {placement} is the value written; keep “row|column” wording consistent with sibling messages.

malformed_placement_separator.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}の形式が正しくありません。row|columnの形式が必要です。
malformed_placement_separator.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement lacking exactly one “|” between its row and column parts. {placement} is the value written; keep the literal “row|column” as a syntax example.

no_open_cell_for_result.value: 結果レイアウト：結果セット{result_number}の空きセルがありません。
no_open_cell_for_result.location: Results → Canvas layout: note line under the canvas board shown after a run when a result set could not be placed because every cell of the board is already taken. {result_number} is the 1-based result set number.

no_open_cell_for_statement.value: 結果レイアウトにステートメント{statement_number}の空きセルがありません。
no_open_cell_for_statement.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a statement (or its placement comment) for which no free cell remains on the canvas board declared in the first-line comment. {statement_number} is the 1-based row-returning statement number.

nonpositive_canvas.value: 結果レイアウトを無視：キャンバスのサイズは正の値である必要があります。
nonpositive_canvas.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle error on the first-line canvas comment (for example “-- sqlly 4x2”) when the row or column count is zero, so the whole layout is ignored.

placement_outside_canvas.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}はキャンバス{rows}x{columns}の外側にあります。代わりにその結果セットを自動的に配置します。
placement_outside_canvas.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement that falls outside the declared board, so that result is placed automatically. {placement} is the value; {rows}x{columns} is the board size.

placement_overlap.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}が{conflicting_placement}と重複しているため、代わりにその結果セットを自動的に配置します。
placement_overlap.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement that overlaps an earlier placement, so that result is placed automatically. {placement} is this value; {conflicting_placement} is the earlier one.

reversed_placement_range.value: 結果レイアウトの配置{placement}は、範囲の終了位置が開始位置より前になっています。
reversed_placement_range.location: SQL editor → Result layout comment: squiggle warning on a “-- sqlly result:” placement where a row or column range ends before it starts (for example 3-1). {placement} is the value written.

stacked_tooltip.value: 結果レイアウト：スタック — クリックで結果セットごとにタブ表示
stacked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: tooltip shown while results are stacked as cards, saying a click switches to one tab per result set.

tabbed_tooltip.value: 結果レイアウト：タブ — クリックでスタック表示に切り替え
tabbed_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab bar → Result layout control: tooltip shown while each result set has its own tab, saying a click stacks them as cards in one scrolling view.

preparing_active_grid.location: Results → Results tab (tabbed layout): dim placeholder with a pulsing loader in the main grid area while the grid for the selected result set is still being built after its rows arrived.

preparing_canvas_grid.location: Results → Canvas layout → Board cell: dim centered placeholder inside one cell of the canvas board while that result set’s grid is still being built.

preparing_diff_grid.location: Results → Diff output tab → Run card: dim centered placeholder inside one of the two compared runs’ cards while that run’s grid is still being built.

preparing_stacked_grid.location: Results → Stacked layout → Result card: dim centered placeholder inside one stacked result-set card while its grid is still being built.

query_running.location: Results → Results tab: placeholder with a pulsing loader that covers the results area after a query starts and before its first result set arrives; usually followed by the elapsed time.

with_elapsed_time.location: Results → Results tab: loading placeholder text combined with a live timer while a query runs. {loading_message} is a status such as “Query running...”; {elapsed_time} is minutes:seconds like 0:07.

conditional_rule_not_serializable.value: {column_name}の条件付きルールにセミコロンが含まれているため、ディレクティブとして書き込めません。
conditional_rule_not_serializable.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon on a result tab when a conditional-formatting rule for {column_name} contains a semicolon and so could not be written into the query’s lock comment block.

filter_builder_not_locked.value: 「行をフィルター…」の条件は列ごとのフィルターと違ってロックされません — クエリに残すには「現在のフィルターをWHEREに追加」を使用してください。
filter_builder_not_locked.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon on a result tab while “Filter Rows…” conditions are active, explaining they are not saved in the lock and pointing to “Add Active Filters to WHERE”; keep those menu names matching.

locked_tooltip.value: ロック中：クエリがこの結果を再現します。クリックすると現在の表示に合わせてロックを更新します。
locked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab → Lock icon before the result name: tooltip shown while the query already carries a lock block, explaining that clicking updates the lock to the grid’s current look.

unlocked_tooltip.value: ロック：このグリッドの列・幅・フォーマット・ピボット・チャートをクエリに書き込み、次の実行でも同じ表示になります。
unlocked_tooltip.location: Results → Result tab → Lock icon before the result name: tooltip shown while the query has no lock block, explaining that clicking writes the grid’s columns, widths, formatting, pivot, and chart into the query as comments.

unsafe_comment_line_omitted.value: コメントマーカーが含まれるため除外しました：{line}
unsafe_comment_line_omitted.location: Results → Messages tab: note added after clicking the lock icon when one directive line was left out of the lock block because it contains a comment marker that would end the block early. {line} is that directive line.

completed_with_elapsed_time.location: Results → Messages tab: final clock line after a run finishes. {timestamp} is the wall-clock time in brackets; {elapsed_ms} is the duration in milliseconds with digit grouping; keep “ms” as the unit abbreviation.

completed_without_elapsed_time.location: Results → Messages tab: final clock line after a run finishes when no duration was measured. {timestamp} is the wall-clock time in brackets.

database_context_changed.value: データベースコンテキストを「{database_name}」に変更しました。
database_context_changed.location: Results → Messages tab: line added when a statement in the run (such as USE) switches the session to another database. {database_name} is the new database.
