summary.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: intro paragraph under the heading naming the active shortcut profile ({profile_label}) and counting app commands, commands with custom overrides, and editor actions.

already_assigned.value: {value}はすでに{owners}に割り当てられています。
already_assigned.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Profile: warning shown above the search box when switching to another shortcut profile would make one key combination run two app commands; {value} is the key combination, {owners} the clashing command names joined with “and”. The switch is blocked.

app_command_conflict.value: {value}はすでに{titles}に割り当てられています。別のショートカットを選択してください。
app_command_conflict.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → App Commands list: warning shown when the key combination just pressed while rebinding an app command is already used by another command; {value} is the combination, {titles} the clashing command names joined with “and”.

default_default.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → App Commands list: dim caption under each app command's binding cells showing its built-in shortcut; {default} is the default key combination (or combinations) for the current profile.

default_default_display.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: dim caption on each SQL editor action row showing its built-in shortcut; {default_display} is the platform's default key combination for that editor action.

editor_action_conflict.value: {stroke}はすでに{titles}に割り当てられています。別のショートカットを選択してください。
editor_action_conflict.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: warning shown when the key combination just pressed while rebinding a SQL editor action already belongs to another editor action; {stroke} is the combination, {titles} the clashing action names joined with “and”.

save_app_shortcuts_failed.value: ショートカットを保存できませんでした：{error}
save_app_shortcuts_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → App Commands → Save: error shown when application shortcut overrides cannot be saved.

save_editor_shortcuts_failed.value: ショートカットを保存できませんでした：{error}
save_editor_shortcuts_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions → Save: error shown when editor shortcut overrides cannot be saved.

search_hint.value: アプリコマンド{total_count}件中{visible}件と、エディタアクション{editor_visible}件を表示中。クリックしてバインドを変更できます。Escでキャンセル。アプリの上書き：~/Library/Application Support/SQLLY/keybindings.json。エディタの上書き：~/Library/Application Support/SQLLY/editor-keybindings.json
search_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Search: hint under the search box giving how many rows match the filter and how to rebind; {visible} and {total_count} count app commands, {editor_visible} editor actions. The two file paths are literal and must stay unchanged.

custom.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Profile: label of the profile button (also shown in the pane intro) for a user-defined shortcut set that starts from the defaults and keeps the user's own overrides.

macos_native.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Profile: label of the default profile button on macOS (also shown in the pane intro), selecting the standard Mac-style shortcut set; “macOS” is a product name.

platform_native.value: プラットフォームネイティブ
platform_native.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Profile: label of the default profile button on Windows and Linux (also in the pane intro), selecting the shortcut set native to the user's operating system.

reset.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → App Commands list: small button at the end of an app command row, shown only when that command has a custom shortcut; restores the command's default binding (verb).

reset_2.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts → Editor Actions list: small button at the end of a SQL editor action row, shown only when that action has a custom shortcut; removes the override and restores the default (verb).

button.value: すべてのオーバーライドをリセット
button.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: button at the bottom of the pane, below both shortcut lists, that starts resetting every app and editor shortcut override; first click only arms it and asks for a second click.

confirm_button.value: もう一度クリックですべてのオーバーライドをリセット
confirm_button.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: replacement text of the bottom “Reset All Overrides” button after the first click, asking for a second click to confirm discarding every custom shortcut.

app_commands.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: section heading above the scrollable list of application-wide commands (menus, tabs, windows) and their rebindable shortcuts, below the search hint.

editor_actions.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: section heading above the scrollable list of SQL query editor actions (cursor movement, selection, editing) and their rebindable shortcuts, below the app commands list.

profile.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: section heading above the row of shortcut profile buttons (native, SSMS, Custom) near the top of the pane; noun meaning a preset set of shortcuts.

search.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: section heading above the search box that filters both shortcut lists by command name or key; noun.

reset_all_warning.value: この操作により、アプリとエディタのカスタムショートカットはすべて破棄されます。元に戻すことはできません。
reset_all_warning.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: warning shown under the bottom reset button after its first click, while it waits for the confirming second click, explaining that all custom shortcuts will be lost permanently.

restart_required.value: ショートカットの変更を保存しました。すべての場所で有効にするには、SQLLYを再起動してください。
restart_required.location: Settings → Workspace → Keyboard Shortcuts: warning shown near the top of the pane after a shortcut is changed, telling the user the change is saved but some places only pick it up after restarting the app.

feature_unavailable.value: MCPサーバーの管理は利用できません
feature_unavailable.location: Settings → AI → MCP Servers (browser build): clause naming MCP server management as unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice shown instead of the MCP settings pane.

file_export_options.value: ファイルのエクスポートオプション
file_export_options.location: Settings → Results → Export: section heading partway down the Export pane, separating the general export settings above from the file-format options below (NULL text, line breaks) used when saving grid results to files.

settings.location: Settings → Dialog: title shown in the unified dialog title bar.

arguments.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: label above the Arguments input, shown only for the stdio transport; space-separated command-line arguments passed to the server program.

command.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: label above the Command input, shown only for the stdio transport; the program SQLLY launches to run a local MCP server.

environment.value: 環境（1行にKEY=VALUE — JSONファイルではなくキーチェーンに保存）
environment.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: label above the multi-line Environment box (stdio only); explains the KEY=VALUE-per-line format and that values are kept in the system Keychain, not the servers JSON file.

name.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: label above the Name input, shown for both transports; the display name of the external MCP server, which must be unique.

url.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: label above the URL input, shown only when the HTTP transport is selected; the endpoint address of a remote MCP server.

ai_tool_digest.value: MCPサーバー経由で利用できる外部ツール（SQLLYがこれらを実行することはありません。ユーザーに伝えるか推奨するだけです）：{value}
ai_tool_digest.location: AI panel → Conversation system prompt (not shown on screen): instruction sent to the AI model listing tools of enabled external MCP servers and saying they may only be mentioned or recommended; {value} is the semicolon-separated per-server list.

could_not_reach_server_error.value: サーバーに接続できませんでした：{error}
could_not_reach_server_error.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the Test request to an HTTP MCP server cannot be sent (network, DNS, TLS); {error} is the technical reason.

could_not_start_server_error.value: サーバーを起動できませんでした：{error}
could_not_start_server_error.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the stdio server's Command cannot be launched during Test (e.g. program not found); {error} is the OS reason.

could_not_write_server_error.value: サーバーに書き込めませんでした：{error}
could_not_write_server_error.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → stdio test: error shown when a request cannot be written to the server.

count_tools.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: success text after “✓” when the server lists more tools than SQLLY keeps; {identity} is the server name/version line, {count} kept tools, {total_tools} the server's total.

count_tools_2.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: success text after “✓” when all the server's tools were captured; {identity} is the server name/version line, {count} is the number of tools discovered.

env_keychain_save_failed.value: 環境をキーチェーンに保存できませんでした：{error}
env_keychain_save_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: error shown when Add Server/Update Server cannot store the environment variables in the system Keychain; {error} is the reason.

handshake_timeout.value: サーバーが{value}秒以内に応答しませんでした
handshake_timeout.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the server does not complete the Test handshake before the time limit; {value} is the number of seconds waited.

http_client_failed.value: HTTPクライアントを作成できませんでした：{error}
http_client_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the HTTP client for testing an HTTP server cannot be set up; {error} is the technical reason.

http_read_failed.value: サーバーの応答を読み取れませんでした：{error}
http_read_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → HTTP test: error shown when the server response cannot be read.

initialize_rejected.value: サーバーは初期化を拒否しました：{message}
initialize_rejected.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the server answers the initialize request with an error; {message} is the server's own error message.

last_seen.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row → Tool summary line: suffix appended after the tool count when the list comes from an earlier Test rather than this session; {value} is a date and time or “at an earlier test”.

more.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers: suffix appended to a server's visible tool list when additional tools remain on the server; includes the leading separator space.

more_2.location: AI panel → Conversation system prompt (not shown on screen): one server's entry in the external MCP tool digest; {name} is the server name, {value_2} its comma-separated tools, {more} an optional “more on the server” note.

more_server.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row → Tool summary line: note appended after the tool count when the server offered more tools than SQLLY stores; {tools_truncated} is the number left out.

production_always_refused.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Connections list: checkbox label for a saved connection marked as production, shown greyed and disabled; {name} is the connection name, noting MCP clients can never use it.

server_answered_status_brief.value: サーバーは{status}を返しました：{brief}
server_answered_status_brief.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when an HTTP MCP server replies with an error status; {status} is the HTTP status code and text, {brief} the start of the response body.

server_info.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: server identity shown after “✓” on a successful Test, built from the server's initialize reply; {name} is the server's own name, {version} its version, {protocol} the MCP protocol version.

server_named_already_exists.value: {name}という名前のサーバーはすでに存在します
server_named_already_exists.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: validation error shown when Add Server/Update Server would create a second server with the same name (case-insensitive); {name} is the entered name.

stdio_flush_failed.value: サーバーに書き込めませんでした：{error}
stdio_flush_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → HTTP test: error shown when a request cannot be written to the server.

stdio_read_failed.value: サーバーの応答を読み取れませんでした：{error}
stdio_read_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → stdio test: error shown when the server response cannot be read.

tools_list_rejected.value: サーバーは tools/list を拒否しました：{message}
tools_list_rejected.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: error produced when the server answers the tool-list request with an error; {message} is the server's message. Tool discovery is best-effort, so the Test still succeeds and this rarely appears.

add_server.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: button below the form fields that saves the entered values as a new external MCP server; replaced by Update Server while editing.

allow_private_network_label.value: リンクローカルおよびクラウドメタデータホストへのHTTPテストを許可（デフォルトはオフ）。
allow_private_network_label.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers: checkbox label above the server list; when ticked, Test may contact HTTPS servers at link-local or cloud-metadata addresses, which are blocked by default for safety.

answer_has_no_json.value: サーバーの応答にJSONが含まれていません
answer_has_no_json.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when an HTTP server's response to initialize contains no JSON message at all.

ceiling_read_write_confirm.value: 確認付き読み書き — 書き込みはSQLLYで開き、確認してから実行されます
ceiling_read_write_confirm.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Global ceiling: second selectable choice beside “Read-only (default)”; MCP clients may propose writes, which open in SQLLY for the user to confirm.

command_required_stdio_server.value: stdioサーバーにはコマンドが必要です
command_required_stdio_server.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: validation error shown when saving a stdio server whose Command field is empty.

copied_claude_code_snippet.value: Claude Codeのインストールスニペットをコピーしました。
copied_claude_code_snippet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: confirmation in the status line after clicking Copy for Claude Code; the Claude Code setup command for sqlly-cli is now on the clipboard.

copied_claude_desktop_snippet.value: Claude Desktopのインストールスニペットをコピーしました。
copied_claude_desktop_snippet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: confirmation in the status line after clicking Copy for Claude Desktop; the Claude Desktop configuration snippet for sqlly-cli is now on the clipboard.

copied_cursor_install_snippet.value: Cursorのインストールスニペットをコピーしました。
copied_cursor_install_snippet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: confirmation in the status line after clicking Copy for Cursor; the Cursor configuration snippet for sqlly-cli is now on the clipboard.

copied_vs_code_snippet.value: VS Codeのインストールスニペットをコピーしました。
copied_vs_code_snippet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: confirmation in the status line after clicking Copy for VS Code; the VS Code configuration snippet for sqlly-cli is now on the clipboard.

copied_windsurf_snippet.value: Windsurfのインストールスニペットをコピーしました。
copied_windsurf_snippet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: confirmation in the status line after clicking Copy for Windsurf; the Windsurf configuration snippet for sqlly-cli is now on the clipboard.

could_not_open_server_s_input.value: サーバーの入力を開けませんでした
could_not_open_server_s_input.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the launched stdio server's standard input pipe cannot be opened, so SQLLY cannot send it requests.

env_format_invalid.value: 環境変数はKEY=VALUE形式で、1行に1つずつ、または;区切りで指定してください
env_format_invalid.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: validation error shown when saving a stdio server whose Environment box contains an entry not in KEY=VALUE form.

exited_before_initialize.value: サーバーがinitialize要求に応答する前に終了しました
exited_before_initialize.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the launched stdio server program quits before replying to the initialize request.

external_servers_intro.value: SQLLYが通信できるModel Context Protocol (MCP) サーバーです。テストでは実際の initialize ハンドシェイクを実行し、AIが言及できるようにサーバーのツールを一覧表示します。AIによるツールの実行は今後の対応です。
external_servers_intro.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers: introductory paragraph above the external server list explaining what these servers are and that Test performs a real handshake and lists tools for the AI to mention.

handshake_task_failed.value: ハンドシェイクのタスクが失敗しました
handshake_task_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the background Test job itself crashes or is cancelled before producing a result.

http_test_url_refused.value: HTTPテストで許可されるのは、localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1へのhttps://またはhttp://のみです
http_test_url_refused.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when Test is refused because an HTTP server's URL is not https:// or plain http:// to the local machine.

inherit_global.value: グローバル設定を継承
inherit_global.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Connections list: label of the per-connection mode button meaning the connection follows the global ceiling; clicking cycles to Locked, Read-only, Read/write with confirm.

initialize_no_answer.value: サーバーがinitialize要求に応答しませんでした
initialize_no_answer.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when a stdio server prints many lines but none is a reply to the initialize request.

locked.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Connections list: label of the per-connection mode button meaning MCP clients may not use this connection at all; clicking cycles to the next mode.

name_required.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: validation error shown when Add Server/Update Server is clicked with an empty Name field.

not_available.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Test: status shown when server testing is unavailable.

not_available_2.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Tool execution: status shown when tool execution is unavailable.

open_stdout_failed.value: サーバーの出力を開けませんでした
open_stdout_failed.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the launched stdio server's standard output pipe cannot be opened, so SQLLY cannot read its replies.

policy_saved.value: ポリシーが保存されました。
policy_saved.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server: confirmation in the status line under the install buttons after any policy change (global ceiling, connections, mode, limits) is saved.

read_only.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Connections list: label of the per-connection mode button meaning MCP clients may only read from this connection; clicking cycles to the next mode.

read_only_default.value: 読み取り専用（デフォルト）
read_only_default.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Global ceiling: first of two selectable choices; MCP clients may only read data. It is the default.

read_write_confirm.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Connections list: short label of the per-connection mode button allowing writes that the user must confirm in SQLLY; clicking cycles back to Inherit global.

server_added.value: サーバーを追加しました。
server_added.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: confirmation shown after Add Server saves a new external MCP server.

server_did_not_answer_json.value: サーバーはJSONで応答しませんでした
server_did_not_answer_json.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the server's reply to the initialize request is not valid JSON.

server_intro.value: Claude CodeやCursorなどのMCPクライアントが、保存済みの接続を読み取り専用で使えるようにします。シークレットはシステムのキーリングに保存されます。本番接続は常に拒否されます。読み取り専用は、SQLLYのSQLチェックだけでなくデータベース自体でも強制されます。各クエリは、PostgreSQL・MySQL・MariaDBでは常にロールバックされる読み取り専用トランザクション内で、SQLiteではquery-onlyモードで、読み取り専用トランザクションを持たないSQL Serverではロールバックされるトランザクション内でステートメントの事前チェックを行ったうえで実行されます。
server_intro.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server: introductory paragraph under the section title explaining that external AI tools can use saved connections read-only, production is refused, and how each database enforces read-only.

server_s_answer_has_no_result.value: サーバーの応答に結果がありません
server_s_answer_has_no_result.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: failure text after “✗” when the server's initialize reply is JSON but lacks the expected result section.

server_test_unavailable.value: MCPサーバーのテストは利用できません
server_test_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers: feature name inserted into the not-available-in-browser message when Test is clicked; noun phrase naming the action.

server_updated.value: サーバーが更新されました。
server_updated.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: confirmation shown after Update Server saves changes to an existing external MCP server.

start_stdio_server.value: ローカル（stdio）MCPサーバーの開始
start_stdio_server.location: Mac App Store edition → Settings → AI → MCP → Server row test result: feature name inserted into the sandbox-limitation message when Test is clicked for a stdio server; a noun phrase naming the action.

testing.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: lowercase progress text under the row while its Test is running; the Test button is disabled until it finishes.

tools_array_missing.value: tools/list の応答に tools 配列がありません
tools_array_missing.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: error produced when the tool-list reply lacks a tools list; tool discovery is best-effort, so the Test still succeeds and this rarely appears.

tools_list_not_json.value: サーバーがtools/listにJSONで応答しませんでした
tools_list_not_json.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row test result: error produced when the reply to the tool-list request is not valid JSON; tool discovery is best-effort, so the Test still succeeds and this rarely appears.

update_server.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: button below the form fields, shown instead of Add Server while editing an existing server; saves the changes to that server.

url_scheme_error.value: URLはhttps://のみ、またはlocalhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1宛てのhttp://のみ使用できます
url_scheme_error.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Status line below the form: validation error shown when saving an HTTP server whose URL is not https://, or plain http:// to the local machine.

plural.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: clickable tool summary under a tested server with two or more tools; {icon} is a ▸/▾ expand arrow, {tool_count} the number of tools. Plural form.

single.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: clickable tool summary under a tested server with exactly one tool; {icon} is a ▸/▾ expand arrow, {tool_count} is 1. Singular form.

all_connections.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Connections: All connections policy-scope option.

ceiling_note.value: 接続ごとのモードは、グローバル上限より厳しくすることのみ可能です。レート制限はMCPサーバーの再起動時にリセットされます。
ceiling_note.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server: note below the Global ceiling choices explaining per-connection modes can only restrict further, and that rate limits reset when the MCP server restarts.

connections.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Connections: section heading for per-connection policies.

global_ceiling.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Policy: Global ceiling section heading.

idle_timeout_s.value: アイドルタイムアウト（s）
idle_timeout_s.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: Idle timeout input label in seconds.

install.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Installation: Install section heading.

install_command_hint.value: インストール：cargo install --path client/apps/cli --locked
install_command_hint.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: hint below the sqlly-cli path input giving the terminal command that builds and installs sqlly-cli from source; keep the command itself unchanged.

limits.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: section heading for request and output limits.

max_chars_per_cell_2000.value: セルあたりの最大文字数（≤2000）
max_chars_per_cell_2000.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: maximum characters per cell input label.

max_ddl_per_minute_20.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: maximum DDL statements per minute input label.

max_queries_per_minute_600.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: maximum queries per minute input label.

max_rows_100.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: maximum returned rows input label.

max_writes_per_minute_60.value: 1分あたりの最大書き込み数（≤60）
max_writes_per_minute_60.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Limits: maximum writes per minute input label.

no_mcp_servers_configured_yet.value: まだMCPサーバーが構成されていません。
no_mcp_servers_configured_yet.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server list: empty state shown before any external MCP server is configured.

sqlly_as_mcp_server.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server: pane heading for the local MCP server integration.

sqlly_as_mcp_server_2.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Installation: heading for installing the local MCP server integration.

sqlly_cli_path.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as MCP server → Installation: sqlly-cli executable path input label.

transport.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add or edit server: transport selector label.

cancel_edit.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Add/edit server form: button beside Update Server, shown only while editing an existing server; discards the edit and returns the form to adding a new server.

copy_claude_code.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: first button in the row under the snippet box; copies the command that registers sqlly-cli as an MCP server in Claude Code.

copy_claude_desktop.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: button in the row under the snippet box; copies the configuration snippet that adds sqlly-cli to Claude Desktop.

copy_cursor.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: button in the row under the snippet box; copies the configuration snippet that adds sqlly-cli to the Cursor editor.

copy_vs_code.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: button in the row under the snippet box; copies the configuration snippet that adds sqlly-cli to VS Code.

copy_windsurf.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: button in the row under the snippet box; copies the configuration snippet that adds sqlly-cli to the Windsurf editor.

edit.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: small button between Test and Remove that loads this server's settings into the form below for editing.

open_mcp_activity.value: MCPアクティビティを開く
open_mcp_activity.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: last button in the row under the snippet box; opens the MCP Activity window showing what external MCP clients have done.

remove.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: last small button on the row; immediately deletes this external MCP server and its stored environment, with no confirmation.

test.location: Settings → AI → MCP → External MCP servers → Server row: first small button on the row; connects to the server, performs the MCP handshake and lists its tools, showing the result under the row.

sqlly_cli_path.location: Settings → AI → MCP → SQLLY as an MCP server → Install: placeholder in the sqlly-cli path input, shown when empty; the file path to the sqlly-cli program used in the copied install snippets.

align_center.location: Settings → Results → Date, Boolean, Unique ID, Integer and Decimal panes → Alignment: dropdown option that centers values of that type in result grid cells.

align_left.location: Settings → Results → Date, Boolean, Unique ID, Integer and Decimal panes → Alignment: dropdown option that left-aligns values of that type in result grid cells; the default.

align_right.location: Settings → Results → Date, Boolean, Unique ID, Integer and Decimal panes → Alignment: dropdown option that right-aligns values of that type in result grid cells.

always_local.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: dropdown option that converts date-time values to the computer's local time zone before display.

always_utc.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: dropdown option, the default, that shows date-time values converted to UTC.

boolean.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that formats the matched column as true/false values.

built.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense → Source: dropdown option choosing the built-in local SQL parser for completions (as opposed to the Rust engine).

date.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option, the first and default choice, that formats the matched column as a date/time.

decimal.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that formats the matched column as a decimal number with set places and separators.

disabled.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Query → 2 finger query swap: dropdown option, the default, that turns off the two-finger swipe for switching queries.

epoch_datetime.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that shows a numeric Unix epoch timestamp column as a readable date and time.

horizontal.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Query → 2 finger query swap: dropdown option that switches queries with a left/right two-finger swipe over the editor.

integer.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that formats the matched column as a whole number.

json_path.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that shows only the value at a JSON path (such as $.a.b) extracted from a JSON column.

mask.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that hides the column's value behind mask characters, keeping only a set prefix and suffix visible.

native_as_stored.value: ネイティブ（保存値のまま）
native_as_stored.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: dropdown option that shows date-time values exactly as the database stored them, with no time-zone conversion.

number_style.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that formats the column with a chosen number style (decimals, thousands separators).

rust_engine.location: Settings → Editor → General → IntelliSense → Source: dropdown option choosing the more complete Rust-based SQL parser engine for completions; “Rust” is a product name.

specific_time_zone.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: dropdown option that converts date-time values to one named time zone, revealing a field to choose it.

template.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override → Kind: dropdown option that renders the column through a text template such as {value|upper}.

text_inherit.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Kind: display name of the plain-text kind, meaning no special formatting is applied and the column keeps the default display.

vertical.location: Settings → Results → Gestures → Query → 2 finger query swap: dropdown option that switches queries with an up/down two-finger swipe over the editor.

just_now.location: Settings → Results → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models → Last refresh: timestamp shown immediately after a cache refresh.

open_cache_folder.value: キャッシュフォルダを開く
open_cache_folder.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: button at the left of the actions row (Linux and other platforms) that opens the folder holding cached database schemas in the file manager.

recently_2.location: Settings → Results → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models → Created: approximate timestamp for a recently created cache.

reveal_in_finder.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: button at the left of the actions row on macOS that shows the folder holding cached database schemas in Finder.

show_in_explorer.value: エクスプローラーで表示
show_in_explorer.location: Settings → IntelliSense Cache: button at the left of the actions row on Windows that shows the folder holding cached database schemas in File Explorer.

unknown_server.location: Settings → Results → IntelliSense Cache → Cached data models → Server column: fallback shown when the server name is unavailable.

cloud.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the cloud AI providers page where hosted provider profiles, endpoints, models and API keys are configured.

coding_agent_cli.value: コーディングエージェントCLI
coding_agent_cli.location: Settings → Sidebar and breadcrumb: navigation destination reading “Coding agent CLI” at Settings → ai → coding_agent_cli.

decision_model.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the page for the small fast model that answers quick pick-one, rating or yes/no questions for other features.

fim.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for inline fill-in-the-middle (FIM) autocomplete in the SQL editor powered by a local Ollama model; keep “FIM” as an abbreviation.

mcp.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers SQLLY connects to for tool discovery; keep “MCP” untranslated.

on_device.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for AI features that run locally through Ollama on this computer, so SQL never leaves the machine.

playground.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → AI folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens a scratch area for sending a single test prompt to a configured AI model; nothing typed there is saved.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups all AI pages (On device, Autocomplete, Cloud, Decision model, Coding agent CLI, MCP, Playground).

display.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Appearance folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens fonts and sizes for the workbench (text size, editor and grid fonts).

themes.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Appearance folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the page for choosing Light, Dark or System mode and picking the light and dark color palettes.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups the Themes, Display and Language pages that control how the app looks.

server_explorer.value: サーバーエクスプローラー
server_explorer.location: Settings → Sidebar and breadcrumb: navigation destination reading “Server Explorer” at Settings → data_model → server_explorer.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups pages about how the database structure is presented, currently the Server Explorer tree settings.

logging.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Debug folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens diagnostic logging for the Server Explorer, used to record tree expand/load failures for troubleshooting.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups troubleshooting pages such as diagnostic Logging; noun meaning debugging/diagnostics.

ddl_navigation.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for modifier-click on a table, view or procedure in the SQL editor to open its definition (DDL = SQL definition script).

external_editors.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the choice of outside applications used to open JSON or XML cell values from the results grid.

formatting.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the SQL formatting rules (casing, indentation, commas, line breaks) used by Format Document and Format Selection.

general.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; first Editor page with basic SQL editor behavior such as line numbers, bold text and indentation; distinct from the Results folder’s “General” page.

intellisense.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for how code-completion suggestions are matched and inserted in query tabs; IntelliSense is a product term usually kept as is.

query_history.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for per-tab version history of query text, where each run or editing pause saves a restorable version.

snippets.value: スニペットとクイックアクション
snippets.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the list of SQL snippets (prefix expanded with Tab) and quick actions (named templates bound to a shortcut).

tabs.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Editor folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for which query tabs reopen at launch and what happens to tabs on disconnect; “Tabs” means editor tabs.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups all SQL query editor pages (General, Tabs, Formatting, IntelliSense, Query History, External Editors, Snippets, DDL Navigation).

intellisense_cache.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: standalone page name (not inside a folder), also the breadcrumb and search label; opens management of the on-disk per-database schema cache used by IntelliSense and the Server Explorer.

boolean.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens display options for true/false values in the results grid (yes/no, 1/0, custom text); data-type name.

column_overrides.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens per-column formatting overrides that replace the type defaults for a specific table.column or column name.

date.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens date and time display formatting for results-grid cells; data-type name.

decimal.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens formatting for decimal (fractional) numbers in the results grid, such as separators and negative style; data-type name.

export.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the choice of export formats offered in the results-grid right-click menu and file export defaults; noun.

protobuf_schemas.location: Settings → sidebar tree → Results: leaf naming the pane where .proto files and descriptor sets are registered for decoding Protobuf values.

general.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; first Results page with grid-wide options such as foreign-key labels, row density and cell details dock; distinct from the Editor folder’s “General” page.

gestures.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens trackpad swipe and modifier-scroll behavior for moving between result sets and queries.

history.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for keeping recent completed runs per query tab in the run strip; distinct from Editor → Query History (query text versions).

integer.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens formatting for whole numbers in the results grid, such as thousands separators, metric suffixes and negative style; data-type name.

performance.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens tuning for how large result sets spill to disk and page in and out of memory while scrolling.

sensitive_columns.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens name patterns for columns whose values are automatically masked (hidden) in the grid on every connection.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups all pages about the query results grid: formatting by data type, history, export, performance and gestures.

unique_id.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Results folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens display formatting for UUID/GUID values in the results grid (case, braces, hyphens); data-type name.

advanced.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Workspace folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; last Workspace page holding destructive maintenance such as clearing all app data.

keyboard_shortcuts.value: キーボードショートカット
keyboard_shortcuts.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Workspace folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the list of all app and editor keyboard shortcuts where each can be rebound.

query_resume.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Workspace folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens settings for which query tabs automatically restore their saved state (result layout, diff mode, server and database) when reopened.

scheduled_dumps.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Workspace folder: page name in the settings sidebar, also the last breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label; opens the list of recurring database backups (SQL dump files) that run on a timetable; “dumps” means database export files.

title.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Top level: folder name in the settings sidebar and first breadcrumb segment; groups app-wide pages: Query resume, Scheduled dumps, Keyboard Shortcuts and Advanced.

icloud_sync.location: Settings → Sidebar tree → Workspace folder: page name in the settings sidebar for iCloud sync (macOS only), also the breadcrumb segment and the settings-search result label.

heading.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: pane heading.

intro.value: サービスで使用する.protoファイル（またはコンパイルされた記述子セット）を登録すると、値ビューアはフィールド番号ではなく実際のフィールド名でProtobuf値を表示できます。
intro.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: introduction at the top of the pane.

browser_unavailable.value: スキーマファイルを追加するにはデスクトップアプリが必要です。ブラウザでは、Protobuf値はフィールド番号で表示されます。
browser_unavailable.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas (browser preview): note that schema files can only be added in the desktop app.

add_proto_button.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: button that opens a file picker to register one or more .proto source files.

add_descriptor_set_button.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: button that opens a file picker to register a compiled FileDescriptorSet (protoc --descriptor_set_out output).

reload_button.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: button that re-reads every registered schema file from disk.

registered_header.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: section heading above the list of registered schema files.

none_registered.value: まだスキーマはありません。追加するまで、Protobuf値はフィールド番号で表示されます。
none_registered.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: shown in place of the list when no schema file is registered yet.

message_types.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas → schema row: the message types a schema defines; {count} is how many, {messages} a comma-separated list of names.

more_messages.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas → schema row: trailing item of the message list when it is cut short; {count} is how many are not listed.

remove_button.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas → schema row: button that unregisters the schema (the file itself is left alone).

added.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: confirmation after schema files were registered; {files} is a comma-separated list of file names.

usage_hint.value: スキーマを使用するには、Protobuf値を開き、ビューアのフォーマットメニューで Protobuf を選択して、メッセージメニューからメッセージタイプを選択します。選択内容はその値に対して記憶されます。
usage_hint.location: Settings → Results → Protobuf Schemas: hint at the bottom of the pane explaining where the registered schemas are used.

custom.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style dropdown: option that shows true/false cells with user-defined text; selecting it reveals True and False text inputs below.

t_f.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style dropdown: option that shows boolean cells as single letters “t” and “f”; the letters are the literal displayed values, so translate only if the shown values should change.

true_false.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style dropdown: option that shows boolean cells as the words “true” and “false”; the words are the literal values shown in cells.

y_n.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style dropdown: option that shows boolean cells as single letters “y” and “n”; the letters are the literal displayed values.

yes_no.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style dropdown: option that shows boolean cells as the words “yes” and “no”; the words are the literal values shown in cells.

bottom.location: Settings → Results → General → Cell details dock dropdown: option that docks the Cell Details panel along the bottom edge of the results grid.

right.location: Settings → Results → General → Cell details dock dropdown: default option that docks the Cell Details panel along the right edge of the results grid.

follow_global.value: グローバル設定に従う
follow_global.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Date or Epoch column override → Time zone dropdown: option, the default for new overrides, that shows this column in the time zone chosen under Settings → Results → Date (or the connection's own display time zone).

alt_option.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: option making Alt-click (Option-click on Mac) in the SQL editor open an object’s definition; key names as printed on keyboards.

command.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: option making Command-click (Mac ⌘ key) open an object’s definition; keep the ⌘ symbol.

control.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: option making Control-click (Ctrl key) open an object’s definition; key name as printed on keyboards.

platform_default_command.value: プラットフォームのデフォルト（⌘Command）
platform_default_command.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: default option on macOS meaning the system-standard key, which is Command (⌘); keep the ⌘ symbol.

platform_default_ctrl.value: プラットフォームのデフォルト（Ctrl）
platform_default_ctrl.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: default option on Windows and Linux meaning the system-standard key, which is Ctrl.

shift.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Activation modifier dropdown: name of the Shift key as the click modifier; not offered in the list and only shown if set by hand in the config file, since Shift-click normally extends a selection.

open_new_tab.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Show definitions: first radio button; the clicked object’s definition script opens in a new editor tab (default).

panel_right.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Show definitions: second radio button; the definition script appears in a side panel on the right of the editor.

popup_window.value: ポップアップウィンドウ
popup_window.location: Settings → Editor → DDL Navigation → Show definitions: third radio button; the definition opens in a separate floating window; choosing it reveals popup size options.

errors_only.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log level dropdown: option that records only failures from the Server Explorer tree to the diagnostic log file.

off.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log level dropdown: default option that turns diagnostic logging off; adjective meaning disabled.

verbose_timing.location: Settings → Debug → Logging → Log level dropdown: option that records every Server Explorer expand, load and failure, including how long each step took.

by_name.location: Settings → Results → Date → Show integer timestamps as dates dropdown: option that shows integer columns named like created_at or event_time as dates.

by_name_and_range.value: 名前と値の範囲で判定
by_name_and_range.location: Settings → Results → Date → Show integer timestamps as dates dropdown: option that, like By column name, also requires each value to look like a date between 2000 and 2100.

off.location: Settings → Results → Date → Show integer timestamps as dates dropdown: option, the default, that leaves integer columns as plain numbers.

auto.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → epoch column override → Epoch unit dropdown: option that guesses whether the stored Unix timestamp number is in seconds or milliseconds; short for automatic.

milliseconds.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → epoch column override → Epoch unit dropdown: option stating the column’s Unix timestamp numbers count milliseconds since 1970.

seconds.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → epoch column override → Epoch unit dropdown: option stating the column’s Unix timestamp numbers count seconds since 1970.

beside_raw_key.location: Settings → Results → General → FK label mode dropdown: default option that shows the referenced row’s readable label next to the foreign-key ID value in grid cells, keeping the ID visible.

replace_key.location: Settings → Results → General → FK label mode dropdown: option that shows only the referenced row’s readable label in foreign-key cells, hiding the ID value; imperative/short phrase.

comfortable.location: Settings → Results → General → Row density dropdown: option for the tallest, most spacious results-grid rows with larger text.

compact.location: Settings → Results → General → Row density dropdown: option for the shortest, tightest results-grid rows so more rows fit on screen.

normal.location: Settings → Results → General → Row density dropdown: middle option for standard results-grid row height.

minus_sign_42.location: Settings → Results → Integer and Decimal pages → Negative format → Negative dropdown: option showing negative numbers with a leading minus, as in the example -42; keep the example number.

parentheses_42.location: Settings → Results → Integer and Decimal pages → Negative format → Negative dropdown: accounting option showing negative numbers in parentheses, as in the example (42); keep the example.

bytes.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → number column override → Style dropdown: option that shows the column’s numbers as data sizes (KB, MB, GB).

fixed.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → number column override → Style dropdown: option that shows the column’s numbers with a fixed number of decimal places.

percent.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → number column override → Style dropdown: option that shows the column’s numbers as percentages.

both_saved_unsaved_queries.value: 保存済み・未保存の両方のクエリ
both_saved_unsaved_queries.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Default dropdown: default option; every query tab, saved to a file or not, automatically restores its state when reopened.

manually.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Default dropdown: option where state restore is off by default but can be switched on per query from its toolbar; adverb meaning “only when you choose”.

none.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Default dropdown: option that disables state restore for all queries and greys out the per-query toolbar toggle.

saved_queries_only.value: 保存済みのクエリのみ
saved_queries_only.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Default dropdown: option restoring state only for query tabs saved as files on disk.

unsaved_queries_only.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume → Default dropdown: option restoring state only for query tabs never saved to a file.

both.value: 保存済み・未保存の両方のクエリで、クエリの状態を自動的に再開します。各クエリのツールバーから個別にオフにすることもできます。
both.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: explanation hint under the Default dropdown when “Both saved and unsaved queries” is selected; notes each query can still opt out from its toolbar.

manual.value: 「手動」は、クエリ状態の自動再開がデフォルトでオフであることを意味します。他のオプションは選択した種類のクエリでデフォルトでオンになりますが、どのクエリでもオフにできます。
manual.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: explanation hint under the Default dropdown when “Manually” is selected, also always shown as a warning at the bottom of the page under Reconnect; explains how Manually differs from the other choices.

none.value: クエリ状態の再開はすべてのクエリで無効になり、クエリごとに有効にすることはできません。ツールバーの切り替えも無効になります。既定ではオフにしつつ個々のクエリで有効化したい場合は、代わりに「手動で」を選択してください。
none.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: explanation hint under the Default dropdown when “None” is selected; says the toolbar toggle is disabled and suggests Manually instead.

saved_only.value: ディスクに保存されたクエリに対してのみ、クエリ状態を再開します。各クエリは、引き続きツールバーからオン/オフを切り替えられます。
saved_only.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: explanation hint under the Default dropdown when “Saved queries only” is selected; describes restore for queries saved as files.

unsaved_only.value: まだディスクに保存されていないクエリに対してのみ、クエリ状態を再開します。各クエリは、引き続きツールバーからオン/オフを切り替えられます。
unsaved_only.location: Settings → Workspace → Query resume: explanation hint under the Default dropdown when “Unsaved queries only” is selected; describes restore for queries never saved to a file.

only_query_changes.value: クエリが変わったときのみ
only_query_changes.location: Settings → Results → History → Store a run dropdown: option keeping a run in history only when the SQL text differs from the previous run.

only_results_change.value: 結果が変わったときのみ
only_results_change.location: Settings → Results → History → Store a run dropdown: option keeping a run in history only when the returned rows differ from the previous run.

query_and_results_change.value: クエリと結果の両方が変わったときのみ
query_and_results_change.location: Settings → Results → History → Store a run dropdown: strictest option; a completed run is kept in the tab’s run history only if both the SQL text and the returned rows differ from the previous run.

query_results_change.value: クエリまたは結果が変わったとき
query_results_change.location: Settings → Results → History → Store a run dropdown: default option keeping a run in history when either the SQL text or the returned rows differ from the previous run.

dark.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode: second of three pill buttons above the palette galleries; switches the app to the dark color scheme.

high_contrast.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode: name of the legacy high-contrast mode; not shown as a pill (older settings with it are moved to Dark with the high-contrast palette), so rarely visible.

light.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode: first of three pill buttons above the palette galleries; switches the app to the light color scheme.

system.location: Settings → Appearance → Themes → Mode: third pill button; follows the operating system’s light/dark setting, using the Light theme by day and Dark by night.

example_1234_none.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Thousands separator dropdown: option for no digit-group separator, shown as the example 1234 followed by “(none)”; keep the number unchanged.

binary.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for binary (bytes) values.

boolean.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for true/false values.

date.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for dates and times.

number.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for numbers (and epoch timestamps).

text.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for text values.

uuid.location: Settings → Results → General → Color cells by data type → per-kind color rows: name of the row for unique ID (UUID / GUID) values.

auto_mask_sensitive_columns.value: 機密列を自動的にマスクする
auto_mask_sensitive_columns.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns: master checkbox below the intro that turns automatic masking of columns matching the listed name patterns on or off.

color_cells_by_data_type.value: データ型でセルを色分けする
color_cells_by_data_type.location: Settings → Results → General: checkbox that tints each results-grid cell's background by its data type (number, date, boolean, ID, binary, text).

decimal_metric_suffixes.value: 大きな数値をK / M / G / T / Pで短縮表示する
decimal_metric_suffixes.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: checkbox below the separator dropdowns that shows large decimal numbers abbreviated with metric suffixes K, M, G, T, P; keep the letters.

enable_grid_animations.value: グリッドアニメーションを有効にする
enable_grid_animations.location: Settings → Results → General: first checkbox on the pane; turns the results grid's fades, dialog transitions and macOS-style scroll physics on or off.

formula_protection.value: スプレッドシートの数式から保護する（=、+、-、@ の前にアポストロフィを付ける）
formula_protection.location: Settings → Results → Export → Spreadsheet safety: checkbox that prefixes cell text starting with =, +, - or @ with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run it as a formula; keep the symbols as written.

gzip_compress_files.value: Gzipでファイルを圧縮する
gzip_compress_files.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: checkbox that makes Save Results and grid file exports gzip-compress the written file by default.

include_header_row.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: checkbox that writes the column names as the first row of exported files by default.

integer_metric_suffixes.value: 大きな数値をK / M / G / T / Pで短縮表示する
integer_metric_suffixes.location: Settings → Results → Integer: checkbox that shows large whole numbers in the grid abbreviated with metric suffixes K, M, G, T, P (thousand to peta); keep the letters.

keep_history_recent_runs.value: 最近の実行の履歴を保存する
keep_history_recent_runs.location: Settings → Results → History: master checkbox that keeps earlier completed runs of each query tab in the run strip above the results.

mask_copies_and_exports.value: コピーとエクスポートにもマスク書式を適用する
mask_copies_and_exports.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: checkbox at the bottom of the pane; when on, columns with a Mask override are copied and exported masked too, not only shown masked in the grid.

show_code_exports.value: メニューでプログラミング言語のエクスポートを表示する
show_code_exports.location: Settings → Results → Export → Programming: master checkbox that adds the programming-language code exports to the grid's right-click Export menu; enables the per-language checkboxes below.

show_dashes.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID: checkbox that shows or hides the hyphens inside GUID/UUID values in the results grid.

show_foreign_key_labels.value: 外部キーのラベルを表示する
show_foreign_key_labels.location: Settings → Results → General: checkbox that shows a readable label from the referenced table next to or instead of foreign-key values in the grid.

syntax_color_structured.value: セル内の構造化値を構文ハイライトする
syntax_color_structured.location: Settings → Results → General: checkbox that colors JSON and XML values inside results-grid cells like code.

use_thousands_separators.location: Settings → Results → Integer: first checkbox on the pane; groups digits of whole numbers in the grid with thousands separators (e.g. 1,234,567).

use_thousands_separators_2.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: checkbox below the Places stepper; groups the integer digits of decimal numbers in the grid with thousands separators.

use_thousands_separators_3.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: checkbox under a Number-kind override in the overrides list; groups digits with thousands separators for that one column only.

boolean.location: Settings → Results → Boolean: title at the top of the pane that sets how true/false values are displayed in the results grid.

column_overrides.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: title at the top of the pane listing per-column formatting overrides for the results grid.

date.location: Settings → Results → Date: title at the top of the pane that sets how date and time values are displayed in the results grid.

decimal.location: Settings → Results → Decimal: title at the top of the pane that sets how decimal (fractional) numbers are displayed in the results grid.

export.location: Settings → Results → Export: title at the top of the pane choosing which formats appear in the results-grid Export menu.

file_export_options.value: ファイルエクスポートオプション
file_export_options.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: title of the lower block holding defaults for Save Results and grid file exports (NULL text, line breaks, header row, gzip).

general.location: Settings → Results → General: title at the top of the pane with general results-grid options (animations, column auto-size, cell colors, FK labels, density).

history.location: Settings → Results → History: title at the top of the pane controlling the per-tab history of earlier query runs.

integer.location: Settings → Results → Integer: title at the top of the pane that sets how whole numbers are displayed in the results grid.

sensitive_columns.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns: title at the top of the pane for automatic masking of columns whose names match patterns (e.g. passwords).

unique_id.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID: title at the top of the pane that sets how GUID/UUID values are displayed in the results grid.

auto_size_columns.value: 文字数。クエリを実行すると、各列は名前と値に合わせて、この文字数を上限にサイズ調整されます。それより長い値や列名は省略記号で切り詰められます。0 を指定すると常に内容全体に合わせます。デフォルトは30です。
auto_size_columns.location: Settings → Results → General: help text under the “Auto-size columns up to” stepper; starts with the unit (characters) and explains the width limit, ellipsis, 0 and the default.

color_cells_by_type.value: 各セルの背景を、そのデータの種類で色分けします — 数値、日付、ブール値、一意のID、バイナリ値、テキストにそれぞれ固有の色が付くため、型の混在する列も一目で読めます。条件付きフォーマットのルールは適用される場所で常に優先されます。マスクされた列は色分けされません。
color_cells_by_type.location: Settings → Results → General: help text under the color-by-data-type checkbox describing the tinting and that conditional formatting wins and masked columns stay untinted.

email_not_masked.value: メールアドレスは既定ではマスクされません。ポリシーで必要な場合は*email*を追加してください。
email_not_masked.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns: note below the Add and Restore defaults buttons saying email columns are not masked unless the *email* pattern is added; keep *email* literal.

epoch_auto_detect.value: created_at、updated_ts、event_time、timestamp などの名前の整数列は、表示タイムゾーンの日付として表示されます。response_time などの期間を表す値はそのままです。「名前と値範囲によって」では、2000〜2100 以外の値も数値のまま表示されます。コピー・編集・エクスポートでは生の数値が保持され、列オーバーライドが常に優先されます。
epoch_auto_detect.location: Settings → Results → Date → Integer timestamps: help text under the Show integer timestamps as dates dropdown.

filename_pattern_tokens.location: Settings → Results → Export → Batch export pattern: help text under the filename input listing the placeholder tokens and default pattern; keep the braced tokens unchanged.

formula_protection_scope.value: CSV と TSV のファイルとクリップボードへのコピーに適用されます。スプレッドシートが数式として実行してしまうテキストは、表示テキストとして書き込まれます。-12.5 のような普通の数値はそのままです。
formula_protection_scope.location: Settings → Results → Export → Spreadsheet safety: help text under the formula-protection checkbox explaining which outputs it affects and that plain negative numbers stay unchanged.

grid_animations.value: 結果グリッドとピボットでの、セルと選択範囲のフェード、ダイアログの切り替え、macOS 風のスクロール物理演算（ラバーバンド式のオーバースクロール、バウンスバック、なめらかなホイールスクロール）を制御します。オフにすると、端で止まる即時スクロールになります。どちらの設定でもデータは常に即座に更新されます。
grid_animations.location: Settings → Results → General: help text under the grid-animations checkbox listing the motion effects it controls and noting data updates are instant either way.

json_path_syntax.value: ドット区切りのセグメントと [index] のみが使用できます。コピーとエクスポートでは JSON 全体が保持されます。
json_path_syntax.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: help text under a JSON-path override's inputs explaining the supported path syntax and that copy/export keep the whole JSON value.

programming_exports.value: 選択した言語で、行をレコード/型の定義と、そのレコードのコレクションを組み立てるコードとしてエクスポートします。
programming_exports.location: Settings → Results → Export → Programming: help text explaining that programming-language exports produce a record/type definition plus code building a list of rows.

run_history.value: 各クエリタブの完了した実行を結果の上にある実行ストリップに保持するため、以前の結果にすばやく戻ることができます。ピン留めされた実行は決して削除されません。
run_history.location: Settings → Results → History: help text under the history checkbox explaining the run strip above the results and that pinned runs are never removed.

runs_to_keep.value: 各クエリタブの直近 N 回の完了した実行を保持します。0 にすると現在の実行のみを保持します。
runs_to_keep.location: Settings → Results → History: help text under the “Runs to keep” stepper; N is the stepper value, and 0 keeps only the current run.

store_run_condition.value: クエリやその結果が前回の実行から変わったときだけ実行を保存することで、同じ内容の再実行が履歴に溜まるのを防ぎます。
store_run_condition.location: Settings → Results → History: help text under the “Store a run” dropdown explaining it skips saving re-runs whose query and/or results did not change.

syntax_color_structured.value: JSONおよびXMLの値に含まれるキー、文字列、数値、true/false/null、タグ、属性に色を付けます。対象はJSON列とXML列、およびJSONやXMLに見えるテキスト値です。各セルの表示されている部分のみに色を付けるため、大きなドキュメントも高速なままです。条件付きフォーマットのテキスト色は引き続き優先されます。
syntax_color_structured.location: Settings → Results → General: help text under the Syntax-color structured values checkbox.

template_helpers.value: ヘルパー: upper, lower, trunc:N, prefix:S, suffix:S, pad:N, default:S
template_helpers.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: help text under a Template override's input listing the helper functions usable in the template; the helper names and N/S argument letters stay literal.

type_colors_custom.value: 任意の種類について、塗りつぶし色またはテキスト色を自分で選べます。同じ色がライトテーマとダークテーマの両方で使われます。「テーマに戻す」は、テーマ既定の色合いに戻します。
type_colors_custom.location: Settings → Results → General: help text above the per-kind color rows shown while Color cells by data type is on.

utc_assumption.value: オフセットなしで保存された値は、変換前に UTC として扱われます。日付のみ・時刻のみの列がずらされることはありません。
utc_assumption.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: help text shown when a converting time-zone mode is chosen, explaining that values without an offset are assumed UTC.

yyyy_mm_dd_hh_mm_ss_yyyy_mm.location: Settings → Results → Date → Format pattern: example patterns shown under the date-format input; the pattern letters must stay unchanged, only “etc.” is translatable.

zone_offset_now.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: hint under the time-zone picker showing the chosen zone's current UTC offset, where {offset} is a signed hours:minutes value such as +02:00.

add_pattern.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns → Patterns: label of the text input below the pattern list where a new glob or regex column-name pattern is typed.

column_overrides.value: 上の書式既定を列ごとに上書きします。列識別子（table.column または column）でオーバーライドを追加し、設定する種類を選択してください。
column_overrides.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: intro paragraph explaining overrides replace the type defaults for one column, identified as table.column or column; keep those identifiers literal.

export_formats.value: 結果グリッドの右クリックメニューに表示されるエクスポート形式を選択します。
export_formats.location: Settings → Results → Export: intro paragraph under the pane title explaining the checkboxes pick which formats the results-grid right-click Export menu offers.

file_export_options.value: 結果の保存とグリッドのファイルエクスポートの既定値です（クリップボードへのコピーには適用されません）。
file_export_options.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options: intro sentence saying these settings are defaults for Save Results and grid file exports, not clipboard copies.

sensitive_columns.value: 名前がこれらのパターンに一致する列は、どの接続でも自動的にマスクされます。上の明示的な列オーバーライドが常に優先されます。グリッドからのマスク解除は一時的です。
sensitive_columns.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns: intro paragraph explaining name-pattern masking, that Column overrides win, and that revealing a value in the grid is temporary.

alignment.location: Settings → Results → Date → Alignment: label of the dropdown choosing left, center or right alignment of date values in grid cells.

alignment_2.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Alignment: label of the dropdown choosing left, center or right alignment of true/false values in grid cells.

alignment_3.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID → Alignment: label of the dropdown choosing left, center or right alignment of GUID/UUID values in grid cells.

alignment_4.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Alignment: label of the dropdown choosing left, center or right alignment of whole numbers in grid cells.

alignment_5.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Alignment: label of the dropdown choosing left, center or right alignment of decimal numbers in grid cells.

auto_size_columns_up.location: Settings → Results → General: label before the stepper setting the maximum auto-sized column width; a sentence fragment completed by the number and “Characters” hint below.

cell_details_dock.location: Settings → Results → General: label of the dropdown choosing whether the cell details panel docks to the right of or below the results grid.

column_identifier.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override: label of the text input where the column to override is typed, as table.column or column.

custom_null_text.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options → NULL text: label of the input holding the text written for NULL cells when “Custom” is chosen.

datetime_pattern.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the dropdown under an Epoch-kind override choosing the date/time pattern used to display the converted timestamp.

decimal_separator.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Decimal separator: label of the dropdown choosing the character between whole and fractional digits (dot, comma, etc.).

decimals.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the stepper under a Number-kind override setting how many digits after the decimal point that column shows.

default_copy_format.value: デフォルトのコピー形式
default_copy_format.location: Settings → Results → Export → Copy: label of the dropdown choosing the format used by plain Copy in the results grid (TSV, CSV, JSON, etc.).

embedded_line_breaks.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options → Line breaks: label of the dropdown choosing what happens to line breaks inside cell values in exported files.

epoch_auto_detect.value: 整数タイムスタンプを日付として表示する
epoch_auto_detect.location: Settings → Results → Date → Integer timestamps: label of the dropdown that shows Unix-timestamp integer columns as dates automatically.

epoch_unit.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the dropdown under an Epoch-kind override choosing whether the stored number counts seconds or milliseconds since 1970, or detects it automatically.

false.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Custom values: label of the input for the text shown for false values; appears only when the style is Custom.

filename_pattern.location: Settings → Results → Export → Batch export pattern: label of the input for the default file-name pattern used by the Export Tables dialog.

fk_label_mode.location: Settings → Results → General: label of the dropdown choosing whether foreign-key labels appear beside the raw key value or replace it; FK means foreign key.

json_path.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the text input under a JSON-path override where the path to extract from the column's JSON is typed.

kind.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides → Add override: label of the dropdown choosing the override type (Date, Boolean, Mask, Epoch, JSON path, Template, Number, etc.).

metric_threshold.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Metric: label of the input setting the value from which whole numbers are abbreviated with K/M/G/T/P.

metric_threshold_2.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Metric: label of the input setting the value from which decimal numbers are abbreviated with K/M/G/T/P.

missing.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the text input under a JSON-path override for the text shown when the path is not found in a value.

negative.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Negative format: label of the dropdown choosing how negative whole numbers are written (minus sign, parentheses, etc.).

negative_2.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Negative format: label of the dropdown choosing how negative decimal numbers are written (minus sign, parentheses, etc.).

null_cells.location: Settings → Results → Export → File export options → NULL text: label of the dropdown choosing what exported files contain for NULL cells.

pick_zone.location: Settings → Results → Date → Time zone: label of the searchable time-zone list, shown when the mode is a specific zone; picking one fills the zone id input.

places.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Decimal places: label of the stepper setting how many digits after the decimal point are shown.

row_density.location: Settings → Results → General: label of the dropdown choosing grid row height and font size (Compact, Normal, Comfortable).

runs_keep.location: Settings → Results → History: label of the stepper setting how many completed runs per query tab are kept in the run strip.

sample.location: Settings → Results → Date → Sample preview: label of the read-only example showing the current date format pattern.

sample_2.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Sample preview: label of the read-only example showing how true and false will be displayed.

sample_3.location: Settings → Results → Unique ID → Sample preview: label of the read-only example GUID formatted with the current settings.

sample_4.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Sample preview: label of the read-only example number 1234567 formatted with the current settings.

sample_5.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Sample preview: label of the read-only example (pi) formatted with the current decimal settings.

scope.location: Settings → Results → Sensitive columns → Patterns: label of the dropdown choosing whether a new pattern matches the column name alone or table.column.

store_run.location: Settings → Results → History: label of the dropdown choosing when a new run is saved (only if the query changed, the results changed, or either).

style.location: Settings → Results → Boolean → Style: label of the dropdown choosing how true/false values are shown (e.g. true/false, 1/0, Yes/No, Custom).

style_2.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the dropdown under a Number-kind override choosing the number style for that column.

template.location: Settings → Results → Column overrides: label of the text input under a Template-kind override where the display template for that column's values is typed.
